lemmas.def_zh: 栗色, 栗色动物, 三岁雄鹿, 酸模, 酢浆草
lemmas.def_en: any plant or flower of the genus Oxalis

examples.en: He rode a handsome sorrel horse along the edge of the forest.
examples.zh: 他骑着一匹漂亮的栗色马沿着森林边缘行进。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sorrel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a hand tool that is used to hold or twist a nut or bolt

examples.en: He used an adjustable spanner to loosen the rusted metal bolt quickly.
examples.zh: 他用一把活动扳手迅速拧松了那个生锈的金属螺栓。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 spanner 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (during prohibition) an illegal barroom

examples.en: Customers had to whisper a secret password to enter the underground speakeasy.
examples.zh: 顾客必须低声说出秘密暗号才能进入这家地下酒吧。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 speakeasy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 断奏的, 断续的, 不连贯的
lemmas.def_en: (music) marked by or composed of disconnected parts or sounds; cut short crisply

examples.en: We were startled by the sudden staccato burst of loud machine gunfire.
examples.zh: 突然爆发的连珠炮般的机枪声把我们吓了一跳。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 staccato 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 认真的, 沉着的, 固定的
lemmas.def_en: characterized by dignity and propriety

examples.en: The staid old law firm rarely embraced modern working methods or technology.
examples.zh: 这家沉稳古板的旧律所很少采用现代的工作方式或技术。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 staid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a city district known for its vice and high crime rate

examples.en: The chef seasoned the tenderloin with fresh herbs before searing it perfectly.
examples.zh: 厨师在完美煎烤里脊肉之前，先用新鲜香草对其进行了调味。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tenderloin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: large genus of Old World mints: thyme

examples.en: The thymus plays an essential role in training and developing T cells.
examples.zh: 胸腺在T细胞的训练和发育中起着至关重要的作用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 thymus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 潮水, 有潮水域, 低洼海岸
lemmas.def_en: low-lying coastal land drained by tidal streams

examples.en: Many historic plantations were established along the fertile rivers of the tidewater.
examples.zh: 许多历史悠久的庄园都建在有潮水域肥沃的河流沿岸。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tidewater 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: male cat

examples.en: A battle-scarred tomcat wandered around the alley looking for scraps of food.
examples.zh: 一只满身伤痕的公猫在小巷里徘徊，寻找残羹剩饭。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tomcat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a plant of the genus Valeriana having lobed or dissected leaves and cymose white or pink flowers

examples.en: She drank a warm cup of valerian tea to relieve her insomnia.
examples.zh: 她喝了一杯热缬草茶来缓解自己的失眠症。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 valerian 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the necessary means (especially financial means)

examples.en: The startup lacked the financial wherewithal to compete with established global tech giants.
examples.zh: 这家初创公司缺乏与成熟的全球科技巨头竞争所需的财力。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wherewithal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: hours or days of work in a calendar week

examples.en: Many modern tech companies are experimenting with a flexible four-day workweek.
examples.zh: 许多现代科技公司正在试验弹性的四天工作制。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 workweek 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an old breed of powerful deep-chested smooth-coated dog used chiefly as a watchdog and guard dog

examples.en: The gentle mastiff rested quietly beside the fireplace, guarding the whole family.
examples.zh: 那只温顺的大驯犬安静地在壁炉旁休息，守护着全家。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mastiff 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 逊原子的, 原子内的, 比原子更小的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to constituents of the atom or forces within the atom

examples.en: Physicists use massive particle accelerators to study subatomic interactions in laboratories.
examples.zh: 物理学家在实验室中使用巨型粒子加速器来研究亚原子相互作用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 subatomic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: tiresomely long; seemingly without end

examples.en: We sat through an interminable afternoon meeting that could have been an email.
examples.zh: 我们熬过了一场本可以用电子邮件解决的冗长午后会议。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 interminable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a treatment for addiction to drugs or alcohol intended to remove the physiological effects of the addictive substances

examples.en: The liver plays an essential role in the body's natural detoxification process.
examples.zh: 肝脏在人体的自然解毒过程中起着至关重要的作用。

lemmas.def_en: remove poison from

examples.en: The human liver works constantly around the clock to detoxify harmful chemicals and waste.
examples.zh: 人体肝脏夜以继日地工作，以清除有害化学物质和废物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 detoxification 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the volume left at the top of a filled container (bottle or jar or tin) before sealing

examples.en: Taking a quiet morning walk helps me clear my headspace before work.
examples.zh: 清晨安静地散散步有助于我在工作前理清思绪。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 headspace 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 诡计, 技巧, 巧妙
lemmas.def_en: a deceptive maneuver (especially to avoid capture)

examples.en: His charming demeanor was merely an artifice designed to win quick approval.
examples.zh: 他迷人的举止只是一种旨在快速获得认可的巧妙伪装。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 artifice 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: in an audible manner

examples.en: She sighed audibly when she saw the massive stack of unfinished paperwork.
examples.zh: 当看到堆积如山未完成的文件时，她清晰地叹了一口气。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 audibly 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a person whose head is bald

examples.en: He affectionately laughed off the nickname baldy after shaving his head completely.
examples.zh: 完全剃光头后，他亲切地对“秃子”这个外号一笑置之。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 baldy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a basin for washing genitals and anal area

examples.en: The modern hotel bathroom was equipped with a heated ceramic bidet.
examples.zh: 这家现代酒店的浴室配备了加热陶瓷坐浴盆。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bidet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (非正式)丢, 使膨胀, 掷, 投, 推, 塞住
lemmas.def_en: give a tip or gratuity to in return for a service, beyond the compensation agreed on

examples.en: Just bung your dirty clothes into the washing machine before you leave.
examples.zh: 你出门前直接把脏衣服扔进洗衣机就行了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bung 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 被偷换后留下的孩童, 矮小丑陋的小孩, 低能儿
lemmas.def_en: a person of subnormal intelligence

examples.en: In ancient folklore, fairies were believed to substitute a child with a changeling.
examples.zh: 在古代民间传说中，人们认为仙女会用调包儿换走真正的小孩。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 changeling 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: liable to be accused, or cause for such liability

examples.en: Any additional services requested during your hotel stay are chargeable upon checkout.
examples.zh: 退房时，您在酒店入住期间要求的任何额外服务均需付费。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chargeable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a kitchen utensil made of material that does not melt easily; used for cooking

examples.en: Investing in high-quality stainless steel cookware will elevate your everyday culinary experience.
examples.zh: 投资高质量的不锈钢炊具将提升你的日常烹饪体验。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cookware 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a culture with lifestyles and values opposed to those of the established culture

examples.en: The vibrant youth counterculture of the nineteen sixties reshaped music and fashion.
examples.zh: 20世纪60年代充满活力的青年反主流文化重塑了音乐和时尚。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 counterculture 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of very poor quality; flimsy

examples.en: We spent the rainy weekend trapped inside a crummy, overpriced highway motel.
examples.zh: 我们在一家价格昂贵、破旧不堪的公路旅馆里度过了阴雨连绵的周末。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 crummy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a hard natural coal that burns slowly and gives intense heat

examples.en: Anthracite produces a clean, hot flame with very little smoke or soot.
examples.zh: 无烟煤燃烧时火焰干净炽热，产生的烟尘极少。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 anthracite 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 向防守方半场的；在前场的
lemmas.def_en: toward or in the defending team's end of the playing field

examples.en: The talented quarterback spotted an open receiver running rapidly downfield.
examples.zh: 这位天赋出众的四分卫发现一名接球手正迅速向前场跑去。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 downfield 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the endometrium

examples.en: Doctors performed several routine tests to carefully evaluate her endometrial tissue health.
examples.zh: 医生进行了几次常规检查，以仔细评估她子宫内膜组织的健康状况。

lemmas.def_en: (pregnancy) the mucous membrane that lines the uterus; thickens under hormonal control and (if pregnancy does not occur) is shed in menstruation; if pregnancy occurs it is shed along with the placenta at parturition

examples.en: During the menstrual cycle, the endometrium thickens in preparation for a potential pregnancy.
examples.zh: 在月经周期中，子宫内膜会增厚，为可能的受孕做准备。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 endometrial 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a very prickly woody vine of the eastern United States growing in tangled masses having tough round stems with shiny leathery leaves and small greenish flowers followed by clusters of inedible shiny black berries

examples.en: Dense greenbrier vines choked the narrow path leading down to the riverbank.
examples.zh: 茂密的菝葜藤蔓堵塞了通往河岸的狭窄小径。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 greenbrier 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 外曲线球, 变向曲线球
lemmas.def_en: a cricket ball bowled as if to break one way that actually breaks in the opposite way

examples.en: The skilled bowler tricked the unsuspecting batsman with a well-disguised googly.
examples.zh: 这位经验丰富的投球手用一记伪装精妙的变向球骗过了毫无防备的击球手。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 googly 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 凹字形楔, 夹条, 雄猫
lemmas.def_en: a unit of information equal to 1024 mebibytes or 2^30 (1,073,741,824) bytes

examples.en: The maintenance engineer tightened the gib to reduce dangerous machine slide play.
examples.zh: 维修工程师拧紧了夹条，以减少机器滑轨的危险间隙。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gib 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to a fetus

examples.en: Exhausted from the long journey, the child curled into a foetal position.
examples.zh: 旅途劳累的孩子蜷缩成了胎儿般的睡姿。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 foetal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a cgs unit of work or energy; the work done by a force of one dyne acting over a distance of one centimeter

examples.en: In classical physics, an erg is a unit used to measure energy.
examples.zh: 在经典物理学中，尔格是用于测量能量的单位。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 erg 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 肠胃气胀, 空虚, 自负, 浮夸
lemmas.def_en: a state of excessive gas in the alimentary canal

examples.en: Certain foods can cause excessive flatulence, leading to severe abdominal discomfort.
examples.zh: 某些食物会导致腹胀，引发严重的腹部不适。

lemmas.def_zh: 肠胃气胀的, 空虚的, 浮夸的
lemmas.def_en: generating excessive gas in the alimentary canal

examples.en: Eating raw beans often leaves people feeling flatulent and noticeably uncomfortable for hours.
examples.zh: 食用生豆子往往会让人连续几小时感到腹胀且极不舒服。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 flatulence 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [植](马来群岛产的)榴莲果, 榴莲树
lemmas.def_en: tree of southeastern Asia having edible oval fruit with a hard spiny rind

examples.en: Although durian has a pungent smell, its creamy flesh tastes surprisingly sweet.
examples.zh: 虽然榴莲气味刺鼻，但其绵密的果肉却出奇地香甜。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 durian 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 好笑的, 滑稽的, 逗趣的
lemmas.def_en: comical in an odd or whimsical manner

examples.en: His droll sense of humor kept the entire dinner party amused.
examples.zh: 他那古怪风趣的幽默感逗乐了整个晚宴上的客人。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 droll 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: one billionth (10^-9) of a second; one thousandth of a microsecond

examples.en: The high-speed trading system executes thousands of transactions in a single nanosecond.
examples.zh: 该高速交易系统在短短一毫微秒内就能执行数千笔交易。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nanosecond 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: structure consisting of a row of evenly spaced columns

examples.en: Visitors walked beneath the ancient marble colonnade that encircled the sunlit courtyard.
examples.zh: 游客们漫步在环绕着阳光庭院的古老古大理石柱廊下。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 colonnade 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 滚动, 移动, 投球；使滚动, 使移转
lemmas.def_en: move heavily

examples.en: Old wooden carts trundle along the cobblestone streets early every single morning.
examples.zh: 每天清晨，破旧的木车都会沿着鹅卵石街道缓缓滚过。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 trundle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an armed thief who is (usually) a member of a band

examples.en: A notorious brigand ambushed the wealthy merchants as they crossed the mountain.
examples.zh: 一个臭名昭著的土匪在富商们翻越山脉时伏击了他们。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 brigand 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of various usually white herons having long plumes during breeding season

examples.en: A solitary white egret stood patiently waiting for fish in the shallow water.
examples.zh: 一只孤独的白鹭静静地伫立在浅水中等待着游鱼。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 egret 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [微]逆转录酶病毒( 一种致肿瘤病毒)
lemmas.def_en: any of a group of viruses that contain two single-strand linear RNA molecules per virion and reverse transcriptase (RNA to DNA); the virus transcribes its RNA into a cDNA provirus that is then incorporated into the host cell

examples.en: Scientists are researching how this particular retrovirus replicates within human host cells.
examples.zh: 科学家们正在研究这种特定的逆转录病毒如何在人体宿主细胞内复制。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 retrovirus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 离题的, 东拉西扯的
lemmas.def_en: proceeding to a conclusion by reason or argument rather than intuition

examples.en: The professor gave a discursive lecture that often drifted far from the main topic.
examples.zh: 教授做了一场东拉西扯的演讲，常常远离主要课题。

lemmas.def_zh: 东拉西扯地, 推论地
lemmas.def_en: in a rambling manner

family_guide.root_logic: 以 discursive 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a female gametocyte that develops into an ovum after two meiotic divisions

examples.en: The mature oocyte was carefully prepared for fertilization in the specialized laboratory.
examples.zh: 成熟的卵母细胞在专门的实验室中被精心准备用于受精。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 oocyte 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the hour at which a meal is habitually or customarily eaten

examples.en: The family always gathers together around the wooden dining table at mealtime.
examples.zh: 每到进餐时间，一家人总是围坐在木制餐桌旁。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mealtime 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 边墙, 侧壁, 轮胎侧壁
lemmas.def_en: the side of an automobile tire

examples.en: A sharp rock punctured the tire's sidewall, forcing us to pull over immediately.
examples.zh: 一块锋利的石头刺穿了轮胎侧壁，迫使我们立即靠边停车。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sidewall 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 教化, 使有德行；说教
lemmas.def_en: interpret the moral meaning of

examples.en: He tends to moralize about youth behavior whenever a problem is mentioned.
examples.zh: 每当提及某个问题，他往往就会对年轻人的行为进行说教。

lemmas.def_en: indulgence in moral pronouncements; the exposition (often superficially) of a particular moral code

examples.en: his constant moralizing drove me mad

family_guide.root_logic: 以 moralize 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: easily irritated or annoyed

examples.en: Lack of sleep made the manager unusually testy during the morning staff meeting.
examples.zh: 睡眠不足让经理在早晨的员工会议上显得异常暴躁。

lemmas.def_en: in a petulant manner

examples.en: he said testily; `Go away!'

family_guide.root_logic: 以 testy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a worker engaged in making steel

examples.en: The experienced steelworker monitored the flow of molten iron inside the scorching foundry.
examples.zh: 经验丰富的炼钢工人在炽热的铸造厂内监控着铁水的流动。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 steelworker 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 延期, 剩余物, 任期届满后仍占据同样地位的人
lemmas.def_en: an official who remains in office after his term

examples.en: This outdated regulation is merely a holdover from the previous administrative regime.
examples.zh: 这项过时的规定不过是前一届管理体制遗留下来的东西。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 holdover 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an athlete who lifts barbells

examples.en: The champion weightlifter chalked his hands before attempting the final heavy lift.
examples.zh: 这位举重冠军在尝试最后一举前往手上抹了镁粉。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 weightlifter 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使受神经支配, 使神经分布于
lemmas.def_en: supply nerves to (some organ or body part)

examples.en: Multiple sensory nerves innervate the skin, allowing humans to feel fine touch.
examples.zh: 多条感觉神经分布于皮肤，使人类能够感知精细的触觉。

lemmas.def_zh: 神经分布, 神经支配, 运动感觉
lemmas.def_en: the neural or electrical arousal of an organ or muscle or gland

family_guide.root_logic: 以 innervate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a railing at the side of a staircase or balcony to prevent people from falling

examples.en: She leaned gently against the carved stone balustrade overlooking the tranquil river.
examples.zh: 她轻轻倚在俯瞰平静河流的雕花石栏杆上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 balustrade 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 反复灌输, 谆谆教诲
lemmas.def_en: teach and impress by frequent repetitions or admonitions

examples.en: Good teachers strive to inculcate a passion for lifelong learning in students.
examples.zh: 优秀的教师努力向学生们灌输对终身学习的热情。

lemmas.def_zh: 反复灌输, 谆谆教诲
lemmas.def_en: teaching or impressing upon the mind by frequent instruction or repetition

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inculcate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不切题的, 鲁莽的, 无礼的, 粗鲁的, 不恰当的
lemmas.def_en: characterized by a lightly pert and exuberant quality

examples.en: The teacher scolded the boy for making an impertinent remark during class.
examples.zh: 老师训斥了那个在课堂上发表无礼言论的男孩。

lemmas.def_zh: 不切题地, 不恰当地, 不礼貌地
lemmas.def_en: in an impudent or impertinent manner

examples.en: a lean, swarthy fellow was peering through the window, grinning impudently

lemmas.def_zh: 不切题, 鲁莽, 无礼, 不恰当
lemmas.def_en: an impudent statement

examples.en: The strict headmaster refused to tolerate such outright impertinence from a junior student.
examples.zh: 这位严厉的校长拒绝容忍低年级学生如此明显的无礼举动。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 impertinent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: capable of being divided or dissociated

examples.en: The monitor and the computer base are easily separable for convenient transport.
examples.zh: 显示器和电脑底座便于拆分，以便于运输。

lemmas.def_zh: 可分离, 分离性, 可分性
lemmas.def_en: the capability of being separated

family_guide.root_logic: 以 separable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: <法>珠宝,宝石,小巧美观的东西
lemmas.def_en: a small and delicately worked piece

examples.en: She opened a bijou art gallery in the heart of the historic district.
examples.zh: 她在历史街区的中心开了一家小巧别致的艺术画廊。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bijou 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a young woman

examples.en: The painter captured the quiet innocence of a young French fille.
examples.zh: 这位画家捕捉到了一位年轻法国姑娘的恬静与纯真。

lemmas.def_zh: 装满, 填充, 弥漫, 供给, 满足, 供应；充满, 变得沉重；填充；填充
lemmas.def_en: make full, also in a metaphorical sense

examples.en: Freshly baked bread began to fill the kitchen with a warm aroma.
examples.zh: 新鲜出炉的面包让整个厨房弥漫着温暖的香气。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fille 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a substance needed only in small amounts for normal body function (e.g., vitamins or minerals)

examples.en: Iron is an essential micronutrient needed for the healthy production of red blood cells.
examples.zh: 铁是生成健康红细胞所必需的微量营养素。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 micronutrient 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a guest cabin

examples.en: The luxury cruise ship offered every guest a spacious and elegant private stateroom.
examples.zh: 这艘豪华游轮为每位客人提供宽敞优雅的私人特等舱。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stateroom 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 具有运动家道德的, 具有运动家风格的
lemmas.def_en: exhibiting or calling for sportsmanship or fair play

examples.en: Shaking hands after a bitter defeat demonstrated his truly sportsmanlike attitude.
examples.zh: 惨败后与对手握手展现了他极具风度的体育精神。

lemmas.def_zh: 没有运动家道德的, 没有运动家风格的, 不公正的, 不光明正大的
lemmas.def_en: violating accepted standards or rules

examples.en: a dirty fighter
used foul means to gain power

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sportsmanlike 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the commercially bred hairless white caterpillar of the domestic silkworm moth which spins a cocoon that can be processed to yield silk fiber; the principal source of commercial silk

examples.en: The silkworm spun a delicate cocoon of pure white silk over several days.
examples.zh: 蚕花了好几天时间吐丝结出一个纯白精致的茧。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 silkworm 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: formulate or develop again, of an improved theory or hypothesis

examples.en: Scientists had to reformulate the skincare lotion to remove all harmful chemical preservatives.
examples.zh: 科学家不得不重新调整这款护肤乳液的配方，去除所有有害化学防腐剂。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 reformulate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 重新计算, 重新估计
lemmas.def_en: calculate anew

examples.en: The accountant had to recalculate the annual budget after the sudden tax increase.
examples.zh: 在税率突然提高后，会计不得不重新计算年度预算。

lemmas.def_en: the act of calculating again (usually to eliminate errors or to include additional data)

examples.en: recalculation yielded a much larger value

family_guide.root_logic: 以 recalculate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a double-reed instrument; the tenor of the oboe family

examples.en: She played a playful, deep melody on her wooden bassoon during the concert.
examples.zh: 她在音乐会上用木制大管演奏了一段欢快深沉的旋律。

lemmas.def_en: a musician who plays the bassoon

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bassoon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any animistic religion similar to Asian shamanism (especially as practiced by certain Native American tribes)

examples.en: The tribe still practiced traditional shamanism to heal sickness and communicate with spirits.
examples.zh: 该部落仍保留着传统的萨满教仪式，以此治病并与神灵沟通。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to shamanism

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shamanism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a large double-edged broadsword; formerly used by Scottish Highlanders

examples.en: The Scottish warrior swung his heavy claymore with both hands on the battlefield.
examples.zh: 苏格兰战士在战场上双手挥舞着沉重的双刃大砍刀。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 claymore 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (computer science) the smallest discrete component of an image or picture on a CRT screen (usually a colored dot)

examples.en: The sensor array records the precise intensity of light at every individual pel.
examples.zh: 传感器阵列记录了每个像素上的精确光强度。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 适于航海的, 经得起航海的
lemmas.def_en: fit for a sea voyage

examples.en: Inspectors confirmed that the repaired wooden vessel was entirely seaworthy for long voyages.
examples.zh: 检验员确认这艘修整好的木船完全适于远洋航行。

lemmas.def_zh: 经不住海上风浪的, 不适于航海的
lemmas.def_en: unfit for a voyage
fitness to traverse the seas

family_guide.root_logic: 以 seaworthy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: tangled mass of prickly plants

examples.en: His woolen jacket was caught and torn by a sharp wild brier.
examples.zh: 他的羊毛夹克被一株锋利的野刺丛刮破了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 brier 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: small short-eared burrowing mammal of rocky uplands of Asia and western North America

examples.en: The small pika gathered dry grass to prepare for the harsh alpine winter.
examples.zh: 小鼠兔收集干草，为严酷的高山严冬做准备。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pika 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: informal or slang terms for mentally irregular

examples.en: The computer system suddenly went haywire, deleting several important files without warning.
examples.zh: 电脑系统突然乱套了，毫无预警地删除了几个重要文件。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 haywire 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a concavity in a surface (especially an anatomical depression)

examples.en: The doctor examined the cranial fossa to check for any signs of internal bleeding.
examples.zh: 医生检查了颅窝，以查看是否有任何内出血的迹象。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fossa 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: lacking courage or vitality

examples.en: Leaving his best friend behind during a crisis was a completely gutless act.
examples.zh: 在危机时刻抛弃挚友是一种彻头彻尾的懦夫行为。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gutless 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: formality in bearing and appearance

examples.en: The veteran diplomat spoke with great gravitas, commanding the full attention of the room.
examples.zh: 这位资深外交官言谈沉稳庄重，赢得了全场的高度关注。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gravitas 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a sweet syrupy trihydroxy alcohol obtained by saponification of fats and oils

examples.en: The cosmetic manufacturer added pure glycerol to keep the skin cream moist and smooth.
examples.zh: 化妆品生产商添加了纯甘油，以保持护肤霜的水润光滑。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 glycerol 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: serving to express or indicate possession

examples.en: In English grammar, an apostrophe with an 's' usually indicates the genitive case.
examples.zh: 在英语语法中，撇号加“s”通常表示所有格。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 genitive 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 愉快, 快活, 高兴
lemmas.def_en: a gay feeling

examples.en: The room was filled with music, laughter, and the unrestrained gaiety of festival guests.
examples.zh: 房间里洋溢着音乐、笑声以及节日宾客奔放的欢乐气氛。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gaiety 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 乡下老头, 老人, 领班, 照明工
lemmas.def_en: an elderly man

examples.en: The movie director worked closely with the chief gaffer to adjust the studio lighting.
examples.zh: 电影导演与首席照明工密切合作，以调整影棚的灯光。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gaffer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 免费软件, 自由软件
lemmas.def_en: software that is provided without charge

examples.en: You can download this image editing tool for free since it is distributed as freeware.
examples.zh: 你可以免费下载这款图像编辑工具，因为它是作为免费软件发布的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 freeware 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 雷格泰姆旋律, 散拍乐
lemmas.def_en: music with a syncopated melody (usually for the piano)

examples.en: The lively rhythm of the ragtime piano music quickly got everyone in the room dancing.
examples.zh: 欢快的散拍钢琴曲节奏很快让房间里的每个人都跳起舞来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ragtime 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: candy made of a thick creamy sugar paste

examples.en: The baker rolled out smooth white fondant to cover the three-tiered wedding cake neatly.
examples.zh: 面包师擀出平整的白色翻糖，将三层婚礼蛋糕包裹得整整齐齐。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fondant 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the apparent surface of the imaginary sphere on which celestial bodies appear to be projected

examples.en: Countless brilliant stars shone brightly across the vast, clear firmament on that crisp winter night.
examples.zh: 在那个清冷的冬夜，无数璀璨的星星在辽阔晴朗的苍穹中闪烁。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 firmament 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a contrived or fantastic idea

examples.en: She assured herself that the strange noise was merely a figment of her tired imagination.
examples.zh: 她安慰自己，那奇怪的声响只不过是她疲惫大脑中的凭空想象。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 figment 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (关于)扩张主义的, 赞同扩张主义的
lemmas.def_en: of or involving or guided by expansionism

examples.en: The empire pursued aggressive expansionist policies to gain control over neighboring territories and resources.
examples.zh: 该帝国推行激进的扩张主义政策，以夺取对邻近领土和资源的控制权。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 expansionist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: abnormal depression and discontent

examples.en: The patient reported feelings of severe dysphoria and restlessness after starting the new medication.
examples.zh: 患者报告在开始服用这种新药后出现了严重的烦躁不安感。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 烦燥不安的, 焦虑的
lemmas.def_en: generalized feeling of distress

examples.en: The patient experienced a persistent dysphoric mood after discontinuing the medication.
examples.zh: 停药后，该患者出现了持续的烦躁不安情绪。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dysphoria 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: two games instead of one (especially in baseball when the same two teams play two games on the same day)

examples.en: A powerful doubleheader was needed to haul the heavy freight train over the steep mountains.
examples.zh: 需要一列强劲的双车头火车，才能将这列沉重的货运列车拉过险峻的山脉。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 doubleheader 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of southern Asia; used in medical research

examples.en: Scientists observed social interactions within the group of rhesus monkeys living in the sanctuary.
examples.zh: 科学家们观察了生活在保护区内的恒河猴种群的社交互动。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rhesus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: outbuilding that serves as a shelter for a dog

examples.en: My grandfather built a sturdy wooden doghouse in the backyard to shelter our puppy.
examples.zh: 我祖父在后院建了一个坚固的木制狗窝，为我们的小狗遮风避雨。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 doghouse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 结婚, 处女膜, 许门(婚姻之神)
lemmas.def_en: (Greek mythology) the god of marriage

examples.en: Medical students studied anatomical variations of the hymen during their specialized training in human biology.
examples.zh: 医学生在人体生物学专业培训期间研究了处女膜的解剖变异。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hymen 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to substances that are toxic to cells

examples.en: The laboratory developed a new cytotoxic drug designed to target and destroy malignant cancer cells.
examples.zh: 实验室开发出一种新的细胞毒素药物，旨在靶向并摧毁恶性癌细胞。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cytotoxic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 北国, 北部地方, 北部地带
lemmas.def_en: any region lying in or toward the north

examples.en: During early winter, flocks of migratory birds leave the frozen northland for warmer southern regions.
examples.zh: 初冬时节，成群的候鸟离开冰封的北国，飞往更温暖的南方地区。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 northland 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: clothing for use outdoors

examples.en: Warm outerwear is essential when traveling through the snowy mountain regions during the deep winter.
examples.zh: 在寒冬时节穿越白雪皑皑的山区时，保暖的外套是必不可少的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 outerwear 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to a wedding

examples.en: The bride and groom exchanged their heartfelt nuptial vows before their family and close friends.
examples.zh: 新郎新娘在家人和密友面前交换了真挚的结婚誓言。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nuptial 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: skill with numbers and mathematics

examples.en: The new elementary curriculum emphasizes foundational numeracy alongside early reading and writing skills.
examples.zh: 新的小学课程在早期读写技能之外，也强调基础计算能力。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 numeracy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 牛轧糖, 杏仁蛋白糖
lemmas.def_en: nuts or fruit pieces in a sugar paste

examples.en: She bought a sweet bar of chewy almond nougat from the traditional confectionery shop.
examples.zh: 她从那家传统糖果店买了一块香甜有嚼劲的杏仁牛轧糖。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nougat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a creation created or assembled by needle and thread

examples.en: Her delicate needlework featured vibrant flowers skillfully embroidered onto a silk scarf.
examples.zh: 她精致的刺绣作品以巧妙绣在丝巾上的鲜艳花朵为特色。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 needlework 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 用不完的, 无穷尽的, 不知疲倦的
lemmas.def_en: that cannot be entirely consumed or used up

examples.en: Her inexhaustible energy and optimism kept the entire team motivated throughout the crisis.
examples.zh: 她那无穷的精力和乐观态度激励着整个团队度过了危机。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inexhaustible 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an offspring of a black and a white parent

examples.en: Historical records describe the author's heritage as mulatto, reflecting mixed African and European ancestry.
examples.zh: 历史记录显示这位作家具有黑白混血血统。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mulatto 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: not growing or changing; without force or vitality

examples.en: Heavy government investment was needed to revive the nation's moribund manufacturing sector.
examples.zh: 重振该国垂死的制造业需要大量的政府投资。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 moribund 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 调情, 寄情, 求婚
lemmas.def_en: sexual activities (often including sexual intercourse) between two people

examples.en: A romantic candlelit dinner set the mood for an evening of gentle lovemaking.
examples.zh: 浪漫的烛光晚餐为整晚的温存调情营造了氛围。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lovemaking 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 盥洗室, 厕所, 洗手间, 洗脸盆, 抽水马桶, 洗礼盆, 公共厕所
lemmas.def_en: a room or building equipped with one or more toilets

examples.en: Excuse me for a moment, I need to use the lav down the hall.
examples.zh: 抱歉失陪一下，我需要用一下走廊尽头的洗手间。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lav 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a ghost that announces its presence with rapping and the creation of disorder

examples.en: The frightened family believed a noisy poltergeist was moving objects around their kitchen.
examples.zh: 受惊的家人认为有个吵闹鬼在厨房里到处乱扔东西。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 poltergeist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: not to be placated or appeased or moved by entreaty

examples.en: The company struggled to survive against the inexorable rise of new digital technologies.
examples.zh: 面对数字技术不可阻挡的崛起，这家公司艰难求生。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inexorable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: artistic design and manufacture of prints as woodcuts or silkscreens

examples.en: She took an evening workshop to learn traditional woodblock printmaking techniques.
examples.zh: 她参加了一个晚间工作坊，学习传统木刻版画技术。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 printmaking 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an athletic contest consisting of ten different events

examples.en: Winning the Olympic decathlon requires extraordinary strength, speed, and overall athletic versatility.
examples.zh: 赢得奥运会十项全能需要非凡的力量、速度和全面的运动才能。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 decathlon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: British writer of short stories (1870-1916)

examples.en: The bearded saki leaped effortlessly between high branches in the Amazon rainforest.
examples.zh: 这只粗尾猴在亚马逊雨林的高枝间轻松跳跃。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 saki 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: occurring during the period around birth (5 months before and 1 month after)

examples.en: Regular checkups significantly improve both maternal and perinatal outcomes during late pregnancy.
examples.zh: 定期检查可显著改善孕晚期的产妇和围产期结果。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 perinatal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the dried stalks and leaves of a field crop (especially corn) used as animal fodder after the grain has been harvested

examples.en: Farmers commonly collect dry corn stover to use as winter fodder for cattle.
examples.zh: 农民通常收集干玉米秸秆用作牛的冬饲料。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stover 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 远地点, 最高点, 极点
lemmas.def_en: a final climactic stage

examples.en: The empire reached the apogee of its cultural and military power under his reign.
examples.zh: 该帝国在他的统治下达到了文化与军事力量的巅峰。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 apogee 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a former province of western France in the Loire valley

examples.en: Sweet Anjou pears are perfect for baking delicious tarts and autumn fruit desserts.
examples.zh: 清甜的昂儒梨非常适合用来烘焙美味的挞和秋季水果甜点。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 anjou 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 微开的, 半开的, 不和谐的
lemmas.def_en: slightly open

examples.en: She left the bedroom door slightly ajar so the cool night breeze could enter.
examples.zh: 她把卧室门虚掩着，好让凉爽的晚风吹进来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ajar 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 经常无故缺席, 旷职, 旷工, 旷课
lemmas.def_en: habitual absence from work

examples.en: The company introduced flexible hours to reduce chronic absenteeism among remote workers.
examples.zh: 公司推行弹性工时制，以减少远程员工的长期旷工现象。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 absenteeism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: spherical Gram-positive parasitic bacteria that tend to form irregular colonies; some cause boils or septicemia or infections

examples.en: Hospital staff took strict precautions to prevent the dangerous spread of staph infections.
examples.zh: 医院工作人员采取了严格的预防措施，以防止葡萄球菌感染的危险传播。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 staph 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: ceramic ware that is fired in high heat and vitrified and nonporous

examples.en: She served the hot soup in heavy stoneware bowls crafted by local potters.
examples.zh: 她用当地陶工制作的厚重粗陶碗盛放热汤。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stoneware 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the science of systematic classification

examples.en: Modern biological systematics increasingly relies on genetic data rather than visible physical traits.
examples.zh: 现代生物分类学越来越依赖遗传数据，而非可见的物理特征。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 systematics 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a narrow-minded adherence to a particular sect or party or denomination

examples.en: The peace treaty successfully reduced dangerous sectarianism that had plagued the region for decades.
examples.zh: 该和平协议成功缓解了困扰该地区数十年的危险教派主义。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sectarianism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 花托, 隆凸, 环面
lemmas.def_en: a ring-shaped surface generated by rotating a circle around an axis that does not intersect the circle

examples.en: The mathematician sketched a smooth geometric torus on the chalkboard for the class.
examples.zh: 数学家在黑板上画了一个光滑的几何圆环面给全班看。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 torus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: in or of the month preceding the present one

examples.en: Please refer to the detailed financial statement enclosed with our letter of the 15th ultimo.
examples.zh: 请参阅随我们上月15日的信函附上的详细财务报表。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ultimo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of a vivid red to reddish-orange color

examples.en: She wore an exquisite silk gown dyed in a vibrant shade of vermillion.
examples.zh: 她穿着一件染成鲜艳朱红色的精致丝绸礼服。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vermillion 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: upright deciduous plant with crimson pods and seeds; the eastern United States from New York to Florida and Texas

examples.en: The herbalist used the bark of the wahoo shrub for traditional remedies.
examples.zh: 草药医生用美紫卫矛灌木的树皮来制作传统药物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wahoo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 水性, 船舶, 驾船技术
lemmas.def_en: skill in the management of boats

examples.en: The marina provides safe docking facilities for various private watercraft and yachts.
examples.zh: 该码头为各种私人水上船只和游艇提供安全的停泊设施。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 watercraft 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (of soil) soft and watery

examples.en: Heavy rainfall overnight left the football pitch completely waterlogged and unplayable today.
examples.zh: 夜间的大雨让足球场彻底泡在水里，今天无法进行比赛。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 waterlogged 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any flowering vine of the genus Wisteria

examples.en: Clusters of purple wisteria draped gracefully over the wooden garden pergola this spring.
examples.zh: 今年春天，成簇的紫色紫藤优雅地低垂在花园的木质凉棚上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wisteria 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 破坏偶像, 破坏偶像主义, 打破旧习
lemmas.def_en: the orientation of an iconoclast

examples.en: His radical artistic style was fueled by a fierce spirit of modern iconoclasm.
examples.zh: 他激进的艺术风格源于强烈的现代打破旧习精神。

lemmas.def_zh: 反对偶象崇拜的, 打破旧习的
lemmas.def_en: characterized by attack on established beliefs or institutions

family_guide.root_logic: 以 iconoclasm 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 后挡板, 背板, 脊骨矫正板, 篮板
lemmas.def_en: a raised vertical board with basket attached; used to play basketball

examples.en: The basketball bounced sharply off the glass backboard and into the hoop.
examples.zh: 篮球猛烈地砸在玻璃篮板上，弹入了篮筐。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 backboard 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a platform where a (brass) band can play in the open air

examples.en: A local brass orchestra played lively marching tunes from the Victorian bandstand.
examples.zh: 一支当地铜管乐队在维多利亚风格的音乐台上演奏轻快的进行曲。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bandstand 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: East Indian tree that puts out aerial shoots that grow down into the soil forming additional trunks

examples.en: Villagers often gather to rest beneath the sprawling canopy of the ancient banyan.
examples.zh: 村民们经常聚集在古老榕树那繁茂伸展的树冠下休息。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 banyan 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a yard adjoining a barn

examples.en: Roosters crowed loudly as morning chores began around the noisy rustic barnyard.
examples.zh: 当嘈杂的农家谷仓场上开始晨间劳作时，公鸡高声啼鸣。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 barnyard 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: curved into a half circle

examples.en: Students sat quietly in the semicircular auditorium awaiting the guest speaker's arrival.
examples.zh: 学生们静静地坐在半圆形礼堂里，等待特邀演讲者的到来。

lemmas.def_en: a plane figure with the shape of half a circle

examples.en: The students arranged their chairs in a semicircle to begin the discussion.
examples.zh: 学生们把椅子摆成一个半圆形，开始进行讨论。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 semicircular 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 安排演出的窍门, 吸引观众的窍门, 经营术, 招徕生意的手腕
lemmas.def_en: the ability to present something (especially theatrical shows) in an attractive manner

examples.en: The magician's flamboyant showmanship captivated the audience from the very first trick.
examples.zh: 这位魔术师华丽的表演才能从第一个把戏开始就抓住了观众。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 showmanship 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a staff surmounted by a crook or cross carried by bishops as a symbol of pastoral office

examples.en: The bishop held an ornate golden crozier during the solemn religious procession.
examples.zh: 主教在庄严的宗教游行中手持一把华丽的金色牧杖。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 crozier 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 可信地, 确实有效地
lemmas.def_en: easy to believe on the basis of available evidence

examples.en: The witness could not credibly explain why his fingerprints were on the safe.
examples.zh: 证人无法令人信服地解释为什么他的指纹会出现在保险箱上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 credibly 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to Socrates or to his method of teaching

examples.en: The professor used the Socratic method to encourage critical thinking in class.
examples.zh: 教授在课堂上采用苏格拉底式教学法来鼓励批判性思维。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 socratic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 大火灾, 大火, 冲突
lemmas.def_en: a very intense and uncontrolled fire

examples.en: Firefighters battled the raging conflagration for hours before bringing it under control.
examples.zh: 消防员与肆虐的大火搏斗了数小时，才最终将其控制住。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 conflagration 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: utter a cry, characteristic of crows, rooks, or ravens

examples.en: A lone black crow began to caw loudly from the withered branch.
examples.zh: 一只孤独的乌鸦开始在枯枝上大声啼叫。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 caw 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: one of the islands of Saint Christopher-Nevis

examples.en: He shaded his tired eyes from the desert sun with a wide sombrero.
examples.zh: 他用一顶宽边草帽遮挡沙漠烈日，护住疲惫的双眼。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sombrero 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (Italian cuisine) squid prepared as food

examples.en: We ordered a plate of crispy fried calamari served with garlic aioli.
examples.zh: 我们点了一盘配有蒜香蛋黄酱的香脆炸鱿鱼。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 calamari 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 畜生般的, 愚钝的, 粗野的, 残忍的, 野蛮的
lemmas.def_en: resembling a beast; showing lack of human sensibility

examples.en: The villain intimidated the townsfolk with his towering build and brutish behavior.
examples.zh: 那个恶棍凭借魁梧的身材和粗野的行为恐吓镇民。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 brutish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 用左手的运动员, 用左手投球的投手
lemmas.def_en: a baseball pitcher who throws the ball with the left hand

examples.en: The clever southpaw caught his opponent off guard with a swift left hook.
examples.zh: 这位聪明的左撇子拳手用一记迅猛的左勾拳打得对手措手不及。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 southpaw 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a light roll rich with eggs and butter and somewhat sweet

examples.en: She enjoyed a freshly baked buttery brioche alongside her morning black coffee.
examples.zh: 她一边喝着早晨的黑咖啡，一边享用新鲜出炉的黄油奶油蛋卷。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 brioche 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 才智非凡的人, 智力超群的人
lemmas.def_en: someone who has exceptional intellectual ability and originality

examples.en: Her older brother is a total brainiac who won the national physics olympiad.
examples.zh: 她哥哥是个十足的学霸，赢得了全国物理奥林匹克竞赛。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 brainiac 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 好读书的, 书呆子的
lemmas.def_en: characterized by diligent study and fondness for reading

examples.en: The bookish young scholar preferred quiet library reading rooms to crowded lively parties.
examples.zh: 这位好读书的年轻学者喜欢安静的图书馆阅览室，胜过拥挤热闹的派对。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bookish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 嫉妒, 羡慕, 勉强允给, 吝惜
lemmas.def_en: be envious of; set one's heart on

examples.en: Nobody should begrudge her success after all the hard work she put in.
examples.zh: 在她付出如此多的努力后，没人应该嫉妒她的成功。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 begrudge 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 市场, 集市, (英)(美)廉价商店, 义卖市场, 百货商店
lemmas.def_en: a street of small shops (especially in Orient)

examples.en: We spent the morning wandering through the crowded bazar looking for vintage jewelry.
examples.zh: 我们整个上午都在拥挤的集市里闲逛，寻找复古首饰。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bazar 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [植]特洛皮(一种澳洲落叶灌木)
lemmas.def_en: straggling shrub with narrow leaves and conspicuous red flowers in dense globular racemes

examples.en: The vibrant red waratah bloomed brightly against the backdrop of the Australian bush.
examples.zh: 鲜红的特洛皮花在澳洲灌木丛的衬托下灿烂盛开。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 waratah 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: large dark-colored scaleless marine eel found in temperate and tropical coastal waters; some used for food

examples.en: The diver cautiously approached a large conger hiding in the rocky crevice.
examples.zh: 潜水员小心翼翼地靠近一条藏在岩石裂缝中的大康吉鳗。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 conger 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: speedy largely terrestrial bird found from California and Mexico to Texas

examples.en: A swift roadrunner dashed across the desert highway right in front of our car.
examples.zh: 一只敏捷的走鹃从我们车前猛地穿过了沙漠公路。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 roadrunner 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a slope or hillside

examples.en: She paused to catch her breath while walking up the steep green brae.
examples.zh: 走上陡峭翠绿的山坡时，她停下来喘了口气。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 brae 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: grasslike or rushlike plant growing in wet places having solid stems, narrow grasslike leaves and spikelets of inconspicuous flowers

examples.en: Dense sedge grew along the riverbank, providing a natural habitat for marsh birds.
examples.zh: 茂密的莎草沿河岸生长，为沼泽鸟类提供了天然栖息地。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sedge 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 用字多的, 冗长的, 累赘的
lemmas.def_en: using or containing too many words

examples.en: His verbose explanation confused the audience rather than clarifying the main points.
examples.zh: 他冗长的解释反而把听众弄糊涂了，没能讲清要点。

lemmas.def_zh: 赘言, 唠叨, 冗长
lemmas.def_en: an expressive style that uses excessive or empty words

family_guide.root_logic: 以 verbose 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (neurophysiology) rapid fluctuations of voltage between parts of the cerebral cortex that are detectable with an electroencephalograph

examples.en: Late last night, she had a sudden brainwave that solved the coding problem.
examples.zh: 昨晚深夜，她突然灵光一闪，解决了编程问题。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 brainwave 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an agreeable or amusing remark

examples.en: After exchanging a brief pleasantry about the weather, they got down to business.
examples.zh: 寒暄了几句天气之后，他们便切入了正题。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pleasantry 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a view of the sea

examples.en: The artist painted a breathtaking seascape capturing the raw power of the storm.
examples.zh: 画家画了一幅令人惊叹的海景画，捕捉到了风暴的磅礴力量。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 seascape 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a person owning or renting a smallholding

examples.en: The local smallholder managed to earn a modest living by selling fresh vegetables.
examples.zh: 这位当地小农靠出售新鲜蔬菜勉强维持生计。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 smallholder 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a circular domed dwelling that is portable and self-supporting; originally used by nomadic Mongol and Turkic people of central Asia but now used as inexpensive alternative or temporary housing

examples.en: During our trip across the steppe, we spent a peaceful night inside a traditional yurt.
examples.zh: 在穿越草原的旅途中，我们在传统的蒙古包里度过了一个宁静的夜晚。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 yurt 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: cast aside capriciously or unfeelingly

examples.en: He was utterly heartbroken after his fiancée decided to jilt him before the wedding.
examples.zh: 在未婚妻决定在婚礼前抛弃他后，他彻底心碎了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 jilt 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a notice of someone's death; usually includes a short biography

examples.en: The morning paper included a touching obit honoring the late jazz musician.
examples.zh: 晨报上刊登了一篇感人的讣告，向这位已故爵士乐手致敬。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 obit 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [希神]亚尔古英雄(随同贾森乘亚尔古舟, 去海外寻找金羊毛的英雄)
lemmas.def_en: someone engaged in a dangerous but potentially rewarding adventure

examples.en: The ancient myth tells the tale of an intrepid argonaut who sought the Golden Fleece.
examples.zh: 古老的神话讲述了一位寻找金羊毛的无畏亚尔古英雄的故事。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 argonaut 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 难辨认的, 字迹模糊的
lemmas.def_en: (of handwriting, print, etc.) not legible

examples.en: The doctor’s handwriting was completely illegible, so the pharmacist had to call him.
examples.zh: 医生的字迹完全难以辨认，药剂师只得给他打电话核对。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of writing (print or handwriting) that cannot be deciphered

family_guide.root_logic: 以 illegible 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 自命不凡的, 势利的
lemmas.def_en: befitting or characteristic of those who incline to social exclusiveness and who rebuff the advances of people considered inferior

examples.en: Her snobbish attitude toward people from smaller towns made her quite unpopular here.
examples.zh: 她对来自小城镇的人那种势利傲慢的态度让她在这里很不受欢迎。

lemmas.def_en: the trait of condescending to those of lower social status
in a snobbish manner

examples.en: they snobbishly excluded their less wealthy friends from the party

family_guide.root_logic: 以 snobbish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 阴沉的, 严厉的, 顽强的
lemmas.def_en: stubbornly unyielding; ; ; ; - T.S.Eliot

examples.en: The old clerk gave us a dour look before quietly stamping our paperwork.
examples.zh: 老办事员面色阴沉地看了我们一眼，然后默默给文件盖了章。

lemmas.def_zh: 严厉地；阴郁地；闷闷不乐地
lemmas.def_en: in a sullen manner

examples.en: he sat in his chair dourly

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dour 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a black-tipped plug clogging a pore of the skin

examples.en: She used a gentle facial cleanser daily to prevent any new blackhead from forming.
examples.zh: 她每天使用温和的洗面奶，以防形成新的黑头粉刺。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 blackhead 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a striking or amusing or caustic remark

examples.en: The comedian delivered a sharp zinger that left the heckler completely speechless.
examples.zh: 喜剧演员抛出一记辛辣的妙语，让挑衅者彻底哑口无言。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 zinger 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a maneuver in a game or conversation

examples.en: The general devised a clever stratagem to outmaneuver the opposing army in battle.
examples.zh: 将军想出了一条巧妙的计谋，在战斗中彻底胜过了敌军。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stratagem 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: facial hair that has grown down the side of a man's face in front of the ears (especially when the rest of the beard is shaved off)

examples.en: He decided to trim his left sideburn to match the length of the other.
examples.zh: 他决定修剪一下左边的鬓角，使其与另一边长度一致。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sideburn 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 写错, 排错, 勘误表, 错误
lemmas.def_en: a mistake in printed matter resulting from mechanical failures of some kind

examples.en: The publisher inserted an erratum slip into the textbook to correct a printing mistake.
examples.zh: 出版商在教科书中插入了一张勘误表，以纠正一处印刷错误。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 erratum 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 授职者, 圣职授与者, 感应器
lemmas.def_en: an electrical device (typically a conducting coil) that introduces inductance into a circuit

examples.en: The engineer replaced the faulty inductor to stabilize the voltage across the circuit board.
examples.zh: 工程师更换了损坏的电感器，以稳定电路板上的电压。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inductor 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: toothless mammal of southern Africa and Asia having a body covered with horny scales and a long snout for feeding on ants and termites

examples.en: Poachers heavily target the pangolin for its unique scales, threatening the species with extinction.
examples.zh: 盗猎者大肆捕杀穿山甲以获取其独特的鳞片，致使该物种濒临灭绝。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pangolin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a diminutive flower (especially one that is part of a composite flower)

examples.en: Toss the broccoli florets with olive oil and roast them until they are tender.
examples.zh: 将西兰花小朵拌上橄榄油，烤至软嫩即可。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 floret 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the scholarly and scientific study of music

examples.en: She decided to study musicology to explore how medieval melodies influenced modern folk traditions.
examples.zh: 她决定攻读音乐学，以探索中世纪旋律如何影响现代民间传统。

lemmas.def_en: a student of musicology
of or relating to musicology

family_guide.root_logic: 以 musicology 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a unit of information equal to 1000 gigabytes or 10^12 (1,000,000,000,000) bytes

examples.en: This compact external drive can store up to one terabyte of high-resolution video files.
examples.zh: 这个小巧的外置硬盘最多可存储一太字节的高分辨率视频文件。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 terabyte 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 轻快活泼的调子, 轻快的动作
lemmas.def_en: a jaunty rhythm in music

examples.en: Her speech had a charming Scottish lilt that immediately put everyone at ease.
examples.zh: 她的说话声带有一种迷人的苏格兰腔轻快语调，立刻让大家放松下来。

lemmas.def_zh: 唱轻快的调子, 轻快地动
lemmas.def_en: articulate in a very careful and rhythmic way

examples.en: Her speech had a charming Scottish lilt that immediately put everyone at ease.
examples.zh: 她的说话声带有一种迷人的苏格兰腔轻快语调，立刻让大家放松下来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lilt 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: microscopic unicellular marine or freshwater colonial alga having cell walls impregnated with silica

examples.en: Under the microscope, the diatom revealed an intricate shell made entirely of natural silica.
examples.zh: 在显微镜下，这种硅藻展现出完全由天然二氧化硅构成的复杂外壳。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 diatom 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 西班牙征服者, 征服者
lemmas.def_en: an adventurer (especially one who led the Spanish conquest of Mexico and Peru in the 16th century)

examples.en: The Spanish conquistador led his troops deep into the jungle in search of golden treasures.
examples.zh: 这位西班牙征服者率领部队深入丛林，搜寻黄金宝藏。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 conquistador 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 娴淑的, 如淑女的, 高雅的
lemmas.def_en: befitting a woman of good breeding

examples.en: Her grandmother constantly reminded her to maintain a ladylike posture at formal dinner parties.
examples.zh: 她的祖母总是提醒她在正式晚宴上要保持淑女般的优雅姿态。

lemmas.def_en: lacking the behavior or manner or style considered proper for a lady

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ladylike 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (medicine) a reason that makes it inadvisable to prescribe a particular drug or employ a particular procedure or treatment

examples.en: Severe liver disease is a major contraindication for the use of this specific prescription drug.
examples.zh: 严重肝病是使用这种特定处方药的主要禁忌症。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 contraindication 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (physics) the property of being isotropic; having the same value when measured in different directions

examples.en: The physicist confirmed the isotropy of the new material by measuring identical properties in all directions.
examples.zh: 物理学家通过测量各个方向相同的特性，证实了该新材料的各向同性。

lemmas.def_en: invariant with respect to direction
in an isotropic manner

family_guide.root_logic: 以 isotropy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 慢吞吞拉长调子的说话方式
lemmas.def_en: a slow speech pattern with prolonged vowels

examples.en: He spoke with a lazy southern drawl, stretching out every vowel with effortless charm.
examples.zh: 他说话带有慵懒的南方慢调，轻松而富有魅力地拉长每个元音。

lemmas.def_zh: 慢吞吞地说, 故意拉长调子讲话
lemmas.def_en: lengthen and slow down or draw out

examples.en: He spoke with a lazy southern drawl, stretching out every vowel with effortless charm.
examples.zh: 他说话带有慵懒的南方慢调，轻松而富有魅力地拉长每个元音。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 drawl 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: having two spouses at the same time

examples.en: The detective uncovered evidence of bigamy when he found marriage certificates from two different states.
examples.zh: 侦探在发现了来自两个不同州的结婚证书后，揭露了重婚证据。

lemmas.def_en: someone who marries one person while already legally married to another

lemmas.def_zh: 犯重婚罪的, 重婚的
lemmas.def_en: of illegal marriage to a second person while legally married to a first

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bigamy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the branch of medicine dealing with the study and treatment of pathologies of the muscles or tendons or joints

examples.en: After experiencing persistent joint pain, she received a referral to the hospital's rheumatology department.
examples.zh: 在经历持续的关节疼痛后，她被转诊至该医院的风湿病专科。

lemmas.def_en: a physician specializing in rheumatic diseases

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rheumatology 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: having two feet

examples.en: Researchers developed a biped robot capable of walking smoothly across uneven gravel surfaces.
examples.zh: 研究人员开发了一种两足机器人，能够在不平整的碎石路面上平稳行走。

lemmas.def_en: having two feet

family_guide.root_logic: 以 biped 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a support for the arm

examples.en: He leaned heavily against the wooden armrest while waiting for the train to arrive.
examples.zh: 他在等火车时，身体重重地靠在木质扶手上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 armrest 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 象形文字, 图画文字
lemmas.def_en: writing that resembles hieroglyphics (usually by being illegible)

examples.en: The archaeologist carefully wiped the dust away to read the carved hieroglyph on stone.
examples.zh: 考古学家小心地拂去灰尘，以识读石碑上雕刻的象形文字。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hieroglyph 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a tale circulated by word of mouth among the common folk

examples.en: The elderly storyteller shared an ancient folktale about a clever fox and a greedy bear.
examples.zh: 老故事讲述人分享了一个关于聪明的狐狸与贪婪的熊的古老民间故事。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 folktale 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 快活的, 活泼的, 轻快的
lemmas.def_en: marked by up-to-dateness in dress and manners

examples.en: He strolled down the street wearing a jaunty red hat and whistling a cheerful tune.
examples.zh: 他戴着一顶活泼俏皮的红帽子，吹着轻快的曲子在街上漫步。

lemmas.def_zh: 快活地, 活泼地, 洋洋得意地
lemmas.def_en: in a jaunty fashionable manner

examples.en: his hat sat jauntily on his full brown hair

family_guide.root_logic: 以 jaunty 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: awaken once again

examples.en: The vibrant spring festival helped reawaken his long-dormant passion for landscape photography.
examples.zh: 生机勃勃的春日节日帮助他重新唤醒了沉睡已久的风景摄影热情。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 reawaken 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: not deterred; - Osbert Sitwell

examples.en: Undeterred by the heavy snowfall, the determined climbers pushed forward toward the mountain summit.
examples.zh: 未被大雪吓退，坚定的登山者们继续向着山顶奋勇前行。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 undeterred 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a new word formed by joining two others and combining their meanings

examples.en: The traveler packed his finest wool suits into an antique leather portmanteau before departing.
examples.zh: 这位旅客在出发前，将最好的羊毛西装装进了一个复古皮质大手提箱中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 portmanteau 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: procumbent or spreading juniper

examples.en: The garden border was densely planted with fragrant evergreen savin bushes.
examples.zh: 花园边界密集种植着芬芳的常绿圆柏灌木。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 savin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: having seven units or components

examples.en: The company reported a sevenfold increase in profits this year.
examples.zh: 该公司报告称今年利润增长了七倍。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sevenfold 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 木制容器, 煤斗, 装木炭容器
lemmas.def_en: an open box attached to a long pole handle; bricks or mortar are carried on the shoulder

examples.en: The laborer hauled heavy bricks up the ladder in a wooden hod.
examples.zh: 工人用木制托斗挑着沉重的砖块爬上梯子。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hod 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (19th century) a man's high tasseled boot

examples.en: Sacks made of rough hessian were stacked high in the barn.
examples.zh: 用粗麻布制成的袋子在谷仓里高高堆起。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hessian 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: lac purified by heating and filtering; usually in thin orange or yellow flakes but sometimes bleached white

examples.en: He applied three coats of shellac to protect the antique table.
examples.zh: 他涂了三层虫胶漆以保护这张古董桌子。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shellac 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a male godchild

examples.en: She bought a silver rattle as a christening gift for her godson.
examples.zh: 她买了一个银摇铃作为送给教子的受洗礼物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 godson 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 踏上高跷的, 虚饰的, 夸大的, 夸张的, 呆板的, 不自然的, 做作的
lemmas.def_en: artificially formal

examples.en: Their dialogue sounded uncomfortably stilted and lacked emotional depth.
examples.zh: 他们的对话显得尴尬呆板，缺乏情感深度。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stilted 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the froth produced by soaps or detergents

examples.en: Thick soapy suds overflowed from the washing machine onto the tile.
examples.zh: 浓稠的肥皂泡沫从洗衣机里溢到了瓷砖上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 suds 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: having the hands covered with gloves

examples.en: The surgeon raised his gloved hands before beginning the delicate procedure.
examples.zh: 外科医生在开始微细手术前举起了戴手套的双手。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gloved 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a sudden emergence of the sun from behind clouds

examples.en: A sudden sunburst broke through the dark storm clouds above the valley.
examples.zh: 突现的阳光穿破了山谷上方阴暗的暴风云层。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sunburst 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 无毛的, 光滑的, 光洁的
lemmas.def_en: having no hair or similar growth; smooth

examples.en: The botanist carefully examined the plant's completely glabrous green stems.
examples.zh: 植物学家仔细检查了这种植物完全光滑无毛的绿色茎秆。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 glabrous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (military) a temporary or supplementary fortification; typically square or polygonal without flanking defenses

examples.en: Soldiers retreated to the fortified stone redoubt during the artillery attack.
examples.zh: 炮击期间，士兵们撤退到了加固的石质防御阵地。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 redoubt 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a thin silk dress material

examples.en: She chose an elegant gown crafted from light, sheer georgette fabric.
examples.zh: 她挑选了一件由轻薄透光的乔其纱制成的高雅礼服。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 georgette 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: underworld organizations

examples.en: Police launched a major crackdown following a series of brutal gangland killings.
examples.zh: 在一系列残酷的黑社会凶杀案发生后，警方展开了大整顿。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gangland 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 日本床垫, 蒲团; （有支架可折叠成长榻的）蒲团
lemmas.def_en: mattress consisting of a pad of cotton batting that is used for sleeping on the floor or on a raised frame

examples.en: Our guest slept comfortably on the foldable futon in the living room.
examples.zh: 我们的客人在客厅可折叠的日式蒲团上睡得很舒服。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 futon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a very loud utterance (like the sound of an animal)

examples.en: Give me a quick holla whenever you finish reading that contract.
examples.zh: 你读完那份合同后记得大声叫我一声。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 holla 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 喧闹, 大吹大擂的宣传, 投环套物游戏
lemmas.def_en: blatant or sensational promotion

examples.en: Despite all the media hoopla, the new movie turned out to be boring.
examples.zh: 尽管媒体大吹大擂地宣传，这部新电影结果却很无聊。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hoopla 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 约束不住的, 抑制不住的
lemmas.def_en: impossible to repress or control

examples.en: Her irrepressible sense of humor always cheered everyone up during difficult times.
examples.zh: 她难以抑制的幽默感总能在困难时期鼓舞大家。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 irrepressible 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of several North American composite subshrubs of the genera Artemis or Seriphidium

examples.en: The vast desert landscape was covered in dusty gray-green sagebrush.
examples.zh: 辽阔的沙漠景观覆盖着布满灰尘的灰绿色三齿蒿。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sagebrush 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the dead body of an animal that has been killed on a road by a vehicle

examples.en: Crows gathered along the highway to scavenge for fresh roadkill.
examples.zh: 乌鸦聚集在公路边觅食刚被轧死的动物尸体。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 roadkill 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: n. <口>( 尤指健美运动员或举重运动员的) 胸肌
lemmas.def_en: either of two large muscles of the chest

examples.en: The bodybuilder flexed his massive pecs in front of the gym mirror.
examples.zh: 健美运动员在健身房镜子前展示了他硕大的胸肌。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pecs 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 教区牧师的住所, 牧师住所
lemmas.def_en: an official residence provided by a church for its parson or vicar or rector

examples.en: The village church stood right across the lane from the historic parsonage.
examples.zh: 乡村教堂就坐落在这座历史悠久的牧师住所对面。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 parsonage 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 公正的人；受尊敬的人；高洁的人
lemmas.def_en: a decent responsible person with admirable characteristics

examples.en: David is a real mensch who always goes out of his way to help neighbors.
examples.zh: 大卫是个真正的好人，总是热心帮助邻居。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mensch 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 成熟分裂, 减数分裂
lemmas.def_en: (genetics) cell division that produces reproductive cells in sexually reproducing organisms; the nucleus divides into four nuclei each containing half the chromosome number (leading to gametes in animals and spores in plants)

examples.en: During meiosis, a single cell divides twice to produce four genetically diverse daughter cells.
examples.zh: 在减数分裂过程中，单个细胞分裂两次，产生四个具有遗传多样性的子细胞。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to meiosis

examples.en: Genetic diversity mainly occurs during the meiotic division of reproductive cells.
examples.zh: 遗传多样性主要发生在生殖细胞的减数分裂过程中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 meiosis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 细木工技术, 细木工活, 细木工行业
lemmas.def_en: fine woodwork done by a joiner

examples.en: The antique dining table is a masterpiece of traditional joinery crafted without nails.
examples.zh: 这张古董餐桌是不用钉子的传统细木工杰作。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 joinery 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 透明的, 光亮的；美国朗讯科技公司（原AT&T实验室）
lemmas.def_en: softly bright or radiant

examples.en: A lucent beam of moonlight filtered through the sheer curtains, illuminating the quiet room.
examples.zh: 一束明亮的月光透过薄纱窗帘洒进来，照亮了安静的房间。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lucent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: jail in a local police station

examples.en: The suspect spent a miserable night in the local police lockup awaiting questioning.
examples.zh: 嫌疑人在当地警局的拘留所里度过了痛苦的一夜，等待审讯。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lockup 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: Australian tennis player who in 1962 was the second man to win the Australian and French and English and United States singles titles in the same year; in 1969 he repeated this feat (born in 1938)

examples.en: Dried laver is a staple ingredient widely used in traditional East Asian soups.
examples.zh: 紫菜干是一种广泛用于东亚传统汤品中的主料。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 laver 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [建]拉莱柱(中间浇注混凝土的钢圆柱)
lemmas.def_en: support column consisting of a steel cylinder filled with concrete

examples.en: The contractor installed a heavy steel lally column to support the sagging basement beam.
examples.zh: 承包商安装了一根重型钢质拉莱柱，以支撑下沉的地下室横梁。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lally 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: knitted clothing

examples.en: She launched a luxury knitwear collection featuring soft cashmere sweaters and warm scarves.
examples.zh: 她推出了一个高档针织品系列，主打柔软的羊绒毛衣和保暖围巾。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 knitwear 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 易分裂的, 易裂的, 分裂性的
lemmas.def_en: capable of undergoing nuclear fission

examples.en: The international treaty strictly controls the production and transport of all fissile materials.
examples.zh: 该国际条约严格控制所有易裂变材料的生产和运输。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fissile 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: one of the sections (or chapters) in the Koran

examples.en: He suffered a painful cramp in his left sura while running the marathon.
examples.zh: 他在跑马拉松时左小腿肚子严重抽筋。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sura 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a goat's horn filled with grain and flowers and fruit symbolizing prosperity

examples.en: The autumn harvest festival offered a cornucopia of fresh local fruits and vegetables.
examples.zh: 秋季丰收节提供了极其丰富的新鲜本地水果和蔬菜。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cornucopia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (music) a pulsating effect in an instrumental or vocal tone produced by slight and rapid variations in pitch

examples.en: The soprano sang the aria with a rich, controlled vibrato that captivated everyone.
examples.zh: 女高音以饱满而富有控制力的颤音演唱了咏叹调，吸引了所有人。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vibrato 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a morbid fear of being closed in a confined space

examples.en: Her intense claustrophobia made riding in crowded elevators an unbearable ordeal for her.
examples.zh: 她严重的幽闭恐怖症使乘坐拥挤的电梯成为一种无法忍受的折磨。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 claustrophobia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the cardinal number that is the sum of four and one

examples.en: He rolled a cinque and a three to secure his victory in the game.
examples.zh: 他掷出了一个五点和一个三点，锁定了比赛的胜利。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cinque 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or containing the carbonyl group

examples.en: The chemist carefully monitored the reaction involving a highly reactive carbonyl functional group.
examples.zh: 化学家仔细监测了涉及高活性羰基官能团的反应。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 carbonyl 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a swift and violent military offensive with intensive aerial bombardment

examples.en: The army launched a devastating blitzkrieg that overwhelmed enemy defenses within a few days.
examples.zh: 军队发动了毁灭性的闪电战，在几天之内就瓦解了敌人的防线。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 blitzkrieg 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a bell tower; usually stands alone unattached to a building

examples.en: A flock of pigeons nested in the old church belfry high above the village.
examples.zh: 一群鸽子筑巢在村庄上方高耸的旧教堂钟楼里。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 belfry 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 穆斯林国家的王后(或公主)
lemmas.def_en: a Muslim woman of high rank in India or Pakistan

examples.en: The wealthy begum generously funded the construction of a new hospital for women.
examples.zh: 这位富有的贵妇慷慨资助修建了一所新的妇科医院。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 begum 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an outstanding example of its kind

examples.en: His vintage sports car is an absolute beaut that turns heads everywhere he drives.
examples.zh: 他的那辆复古跑车极其漂亮，开到哪里都引人注目。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 beaut 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 春天的, 和煦的, 青春的
lemmas.def_en: suggestive of youth; vigorous and fresh

examples.en: Daffodils began to bloom across the meadow under the gentle warmth of vernal sunshine.
examples.zh: 在和煦的春日阳光下，水仙花开始在草地上竞相绽放。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vernal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 驴的, 像驴的, 愚蠢的
lemmas.def_en: devoid of intelligence

examples.en: Nobody in the boardroom agreed with his completely asinine suggestion during the meeting.
examples.zh: 会议期间，董事会里没有人赞同他那极其愚蠢的建议。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 asinine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (of instruments in the violin family) to be played with the bow

examples.en: The conductor signaled the string section to switch from pizzicato back to arco.
examples.zh: 指挥示意弦乐组从拨弦演奏切换回用弓拉奏。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 arco 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 角膜白斑, 白眼, 散开性斜视
lemmas.def_en: strabismus in which one or both eyes are directed outward

examples.en: The doctor examined the patient's congenital walleye before recommending corrective vision therapy.
examples.zh: 医生在建议矫正视力治疗之前，先检查了患者的先天性散开性斜视。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 walleye 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a liquid added to the water in a cooling system to lower its freezing point

examples.en: Make sure to check the level of antifreeze in your car before winter arrives.
examples.zh: 在冬天到来之前，务必检查汽车里的防冻液存量。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 antifreeze 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a garment (as a dress or coat) with a full length opening; adjusts to the body by wrapping around

examples.en: She wore a colorful silk wraparound to the beach every afternoon.
examples.zh: 每天下午她都穿着一件色彩艳丽的丝绸裹裙去海滩。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wraparound 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [希神]阿尔泰亚(卡吕冬王任俄纽斯的妻子)
lemmas.def_en: any of various plants of the genus Althaea; similar to but having smaller flowers than genus Alcea

examples.en: In Greek mythology, Althea caused her own son's tragic death.
examples.zh: 在希腊神话中，阿尔泰亚导致了自己儿子的悲惨死亡。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 althea 为核心的派生词族。
