examples.en: Indigenous tribes have traditionally used peyote in sacred religious ceremonies for centuries.
examples.zh: 几个世纪以来，土著部落一直将佩奥特掌用于神圣的宗教仪式。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 peyote 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a synthetic rubber that is resistant to oils and aging; used in waterproof products

examples.en: Divers prefer wetsuits made of durable neoprene because they offer excellent thermal insulation.
examples.zh: 潜水员偏爱耐用的氯丁橡胶潜水服，因为其保暖性能极佳。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 neoprene 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 夜行者；蓝魔人；蓝恶魔
lemmas.def_en: terrestrial worm that burrows into and helps aerate soil; often surfaces when the ground is cool or wet; used as bait by anglers

examples.en: He used a plump nightcrawler as bait to catch large bass in the lake.
examples.zh: 他用一条肥壮的大蚯蚓作饵在湖里钓大鲈鱼。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nightcrawler 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 女式睡衣, 孩子穿的睡衣, 妇女穿的睡衣
lemmas.def_en: lingerie consisting of a loose dress designed to be worn in bed by women

examples.en: She wore a soft silk nightgown that kept her cool during summer nights.
examples.zh: 她穿着一件柔软的丝绸睡袍，在夏夜倍感凉爽。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nightgown 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of numerous shrubs or herbs or vines of the genus Solanum; most are poisonous though many bear edible fruit

examples.en: Many species belonging to the nightshade family contain dangerous toxic alkaloids.
examples.zh: 属于茄科的许多植物种类都含有危险的有毒生物碱。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nightshade 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: make unfashionable, outdated, or obsolete

examples.en: Modern ways of cooking have outmoded the hearth

family_guide.root_logic: 以 outmoded 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: suffering complete paralysis of the lower half of the body usually resulting from damage to the spinal cord

examples.en: After a devastating car crash, he became paraplegic and uses a specialized wheelchair.
examples.zh: 一场毁灭性的车祸后，他下肢瘫痪，如今依靠特制轮椅代步。

lemmas.def_en: paralysis of the lower half of the body (most often as a result of trauma)

examples.en: A severe spinal injury in the car crash resulted in permanent paraplegia.
examples.zh: 车祸中严重的脊髓损伤导致了他永久性的下半身截瘫。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 paraplegic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a person who passes by casually or by chance

examples.en: An alert passerby noticed the rising smoke and immediately called the fire department.
examples.zh: 一名警觉的路人注意到冒出的浓烟，立即报了火警。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 passerby 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a disease of the respiratory mucous membrane

examples.en: Routine childhood vaccinations have significantly reduced the dangerous incidence of pertussis.
examples.zh: 常规的儿童疫苗接种已显著降低了百日咳的危险发病率。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pertussis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: machine-readable text that is not sequential but is organized so that related items of information are connected; --Ted Nelson

examples.en: The invention of hypertext transformed static electronic text into an interconnected digital web.
examples.zh: 超文本的发明将静态电子文本转变为互联的数字网络。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hypertext 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a recreation room for noisy activities (parties or children's play etc)

examples.en: The colorful playroom was messy with toy cars, building blocks, and scattered puzzles.
examples.zh: 色彩斑斓的游戏室里堆满了玩具车、积木和散落的拼图。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 playroom 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不知疲倦的, 有耐性的, 不屈不挠的
lemmas.def_en: showing sustained enthusiastic action with unflagging vitality

examples.en: Her indefatigable work ethic earned her widespread respect from all her professional colleagues.
examples.zh: 她不知疲倦的职业敬业精神赢得了所有同事的广泛尊重。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 indefatigable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: internal organs collectively (especially those in the abdominal cavity)

examples.en: The hunter cleaned the deer and discarded its entrails in the woods.
examples.zh: 猎人清理了鹿肉，并将内脏丢弃在树林里。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 entrails 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (geology) a column of weathered and unusually shaped rock

examples.en: The old superstition claimed that the cursed amulet brought a hoodoo upon them.
examples.zh: 古老的迷信称，那枚被诅咒的护身符给他们带来了厄运。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hoodoo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 地狱般可怕的地方, 藏垢纳污之外
lemmas.def_en: any place of pain and turmoil

examples.en: The prisoners described the overcrowded facility as an unbearable and violent hellhole.
examples.zh: 囚犯们形容那个过度拥挤的设施是一座难以忍受且暴力的地狱。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hellhole 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 无政府的, 无政府主义的, 无规律的
lemmas.def_en: without law or control

examples.en: The city collapsed into an anarchic state after the sudden fall of government.
examples.zh: 政府突然垮台后，这座城市陷入了无政府状态。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 anarchic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a wall hanging of heavy handwoven fabric with pictorial designs

examples.en: The medieval assassin concealed himself behind a heavy velvet arras in the hall.
examples.zh: 中世纪的刺客隐藏在大厅厚重的丝绒挂毯后面。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 arras 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使馆随员, 外交使团的专员
lemmas.def_en: a specialist assigned to the staff of a diplomatic mission

examples.en: The French military attache met with local officials to discuss new security measures.
examples.zh: 法国武官与当地官员会面，讨论新的安全措施。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 attache 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a large gathering of people of a particular type

examples.en: A bevy of eager reporters waited outside the courthouse for the major verdict.
examples.zh: 一群热切的记者在法院外等候重大判决。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bevy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: reactive or functioning or allowing movement in two usually opposite directions

examples.en: This cable supports bidirectional data transfer between the laptop and the external drive.
examples.zh: 该电缆支持笔记本电脑与外接驱动器之间的双向数据传输。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bidirectional 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the branch of engineering science in which biological science is used to study the relation between workers and their environments

examples.en: Advances in bioengineering have made it possible to create artificial human heart tissues.
examples.zh: 生物工程的进步使得制造人造人体心脏组织成为可能。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bioengineering 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 位/英寸, 比特/英寸
lemmas.def_en: a measure of how densely information is packed on a storage medium

examples.en: Older magnetic tape drives typically recorded data at a relatively low bpi density.
examples.zh: 较旧的磁带机通常以相对较低的每英寸位数密度记录数据。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bpi 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [法] 理由, 原因, 条件
lemmas.def_en: a comprehensive term for any proceeding in a court of law whereby an individual seeks a legal remedy

examples.en: The legal contract was declared entirely invalid due to the absence of causa.
examples.zh: 由于缺乏合法理由，该法律合同被宣布完全无效。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 causa 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: dense vegetation consisting of stunted trees or bushes

examples.en: A dry summer wind swept dangerously across the dense, highly flammable chaparral.
examples.zh: 干燥的夏风危险地席卷了茂密且极易燃烧的灌木丛。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chaparral 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 卑鄙的, 可轻蔑的, 不足挂齿的
lemmas.def_en: deserving of contempt or scorn

examples.en: Stealing money from an impoverished elderly person is a thoroughly contemptible crime.
examples.zh: 从贫困老人那里偷钱是一种彻头彻尾卑鄙的罪行。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 contemptible 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 疯子, 怪人, 狂想家
lemmas.def_en: a whimsically eccentric person

examples.en: Most scientists initially dismissed his radical new theory as the rambling of a crackpot.
examples.zh: 大多数科学家最初都将他激进的新理论斥为怪人的胡言乱语。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 crackpot 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a tendency to be negligent and uncaring

examples.en: The police officer was fired and disgraced for gross dereliction of duty.
examples.zh: 这名警官因严重玩忽职守而被解雇并名誉扫地。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dereliction 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a clergyman; especially a settled minister or parson

examples.en: The ancient Latin prayer reverently addressed the Lord God as eternal Dominus.
examples.zh: 古拉丁语祈祷文虔诚地尊称主上帝为永恒的主宰。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dominus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a newt in its terrestrial stage of development

examples.en: The children found a tiny red eft crawling through the damp forest moss.
examples.zh: 孩子们发现了一只在潮湿的森林苔藓中爬行的小水蜥。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 eft 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or involving an electrically operated mechanical device

examples.en: The early automated factory relied heavily on complex electromechanical switches and relays.
examples.zh: 早期的自动化工厂严重依赖复杂的机电开关和继电器。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 electromechanical 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: belief in multiple Gods

examples.en: Ancient Roman culture practiced polytheism, worshipping a vast pantheon of different gods.
examples.zh: 古罗马文化奉行多神教，崇拜由不同神祇组成的庞大神系。

lemmas.def_zh: 多神教的, 多神论者的, 信奉多神的
lemmas.def_en: worshipping or believing in more than one god

family_guide.root_logic: 以 polytheism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 性爱倾向, 性欲亢进
lemmas.def_en: a state of anticipation of sexuality

examples.en: The director subtly used light and shadow to heighten the eroticism of the scene.
examples.zh: 导演巧妙地利用光影来增强画面的情色意蕴。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 eroticism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 发热的, 热病的, 热性的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or characterized by fever

examples.en: The sick child tossed and turned restlessly in a febrile, hallucinatory state.
examples.zh: 患病的孩子在发热和幻觉的状态下辗转反侧。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 febrile 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 卫兵, (英)近卫兵, (美)国民警卫队士兵
lemmas.def_en: a soldier who is a member of a unit called `the guard' or `guards'

examples.en: The royal guardsman stood perfectly motionless outside the palace gates for several hours.
examples.zh: 皇家卫兵在宫殿门外纹丝不动地站立了几个小时。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 guardsman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 喉咙的, 咽喉的, 喉音的
lemmas.def_en: like the sounds of frogs and crows

examples.en: The tired guard emitted a low guttural sound to acknowledge the visitor's presence.
examples.zh: 疲惫的警卫发出一声低沉的喉音，表示注意到了访客。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 guttural 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: your deepest feelings of love and compassion

examples.en: The orphan's tragic story tugged at the heartstrings of everyone in the audience.
examples.zh: 那个孤儿的悲惨故事拨动了在场每个观众的心弦。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 heartstrings 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 悍妇, 泼妇人, 巫婆
lemmas.def_en: a malicious woman with a fierce temper

examples.en: Her neighbors avoided crossing her, whispering that she was an unpredictable hellcat.
examples.zh: 邻居们都避免惹恼她，私下议论她是个脾气暴躁的泼妇。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hellcat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 用信号联络；打信号, 发旗语
lemmas.def_en: send signals by or as if by semaphore

examples.en: The sailor stood on the windy deck to semaphore vital messages ashore.
examples.zh: 水手站在风口处的甲板上，用旗语向岸上发送重要信息。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 semaphore 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 假设法的, 虚拟语气的
lemmas.def_en: relating to a mood of verbs

examples.en: English learners often find the correct use of the subjunctive mood tricky.
examples.zh: 英语学习者常常觉得虚拟语气的正确运用很棘手。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 subjunctive 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 奉献的, 还愿的, 表示愿心的
lemmas.def_en: dedicated in fulfillment of a vow

examples.en: Pilgrims gathered quietly to light small votive candles inside the ancient shrine.
examples.zh: 朝圣者静静地聚集在古老的神龛里，点燃许愿蜡烛。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 votive 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 上等皮纸, 皮纸文书, 牛皮纸
lemmas.def_en: a heavy creamy-colored paper resembling parchment

examples.en: The medieval scribe carefully penned the sacred text on smooth calfskin vellum.
examples.zh: 中世纪的抄写员在光滑的小牛皮纸上小心翼翼地抄写圣经。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vellum 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 三执政, 三头统治, 三人执政之职
lemmas.def_en: a group of three men responsible for public administration or civil authority

examples.en: A powerful triumvirate of executives took complete control of the troubled corporation.
examples.zh: 一个由三位高管组成的强大三人执政团全面掌控了这家陷入困境的公司。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 triumvirate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the layer of soil on the surface

examples.en: Heavy rainfall washed away the fertile topsoil from the exposed hillside fields.
examples.zh: 暴雨冲走了裸露山坡农田里的肥沃表层土。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 topsoil 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 小符号, 微量, 一点点, 小点
lemmas.def_en: a tiny or scarcely detectable amount

examples.en: The stubborn witness refused to alter a single tittle of his testimony.
examples.zh: 固执的证人拒绝更改其证词中的哪怕一丝一毫。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tittle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 野生植物, 野生苹果树, 野生苹果
lemmas.def_en: a wild uncultivated plant (especially a wild apple or crabapple tree)

examples.en: The botanist discovered a rare wilding thriving unexpectedly in the rocky crevice.
examples.zh: 植物学家意外地在岩石裂缝中发现了一株生长繁茂的野生植物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wilding 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a book containing a collection of songs

examples.en: She kept an antique songbook filled with traditional folk melodies beside the piano.
examples.zh: 她在钢琴旁放了一本满是传统民间旋律的古老歌集。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 songbook 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 希德；殉道者；沙阿伊德
lemmas.def_en: Arabic term for holy martyrs; applied by Palestinians to suicide bombers

examples.en: The monument honors every shaheed who sacrificed their life for national freedom.
examples.zh: 这座纪念碑纪念为国家自由牺牲生命的每一位殉道者。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shaheed 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a workplace where metal is worked by heating and hammering

examples.en: The rhythmic sound of hammer strikes echoed clearly from the village smithy.
examples.zh: 铁锤敲打的有节奏声响从村里的铁匠铺清晰地传出来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 smithy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 洪涛, 急流, 激流
lemmas.def_en: a stretch of turbulent water in a river or the sea caused by one current flowing into or across another current

examples.en: Lifeguards warned swimmers not to venture out because of the dangerous riptide.
examples.zh: 救生员警告游泳者不要涉险下海，因为存在危险的湍流。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 riptide 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a structure resembling a shoebox (as a rectangular building or a cramped room or compartment)

examples.en: He stored dozens of cherished family photographs inside a dusty cardboard shoebox.
examples.zh: 他把数十张珍贵的家庭照片存放在一个落满灰尘的纸板鞋盒里。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shoebox 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: rock that form the continuous lower layer of the earth's crust; rich in silicon and magnesium

examples.en: Geologists explain that oceanic crust consists primarily of dense rocks called sima.
examples.zh: 地质学家解释说，大洋地壳主要由被称为硅镁层的致密岩石构成。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sima 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 紧急的, 迫切的, 苛求的
lemmas.def_en: demanding attention; ; ; - H.L.Mencken

examples.en: The sudden natural disaster presented an exigent need for immediate emergency relief.
examples.zh: 突如其来的自然灾害对即时紧急救援提出了紧迫的要求。

lemmas.def_zh: 紧急, 急迫, 紧急事件
lemmas.def_en: a pressing or urgent situation

examples.en: the health-care exigency

family_guide.root_logic: 以 exigent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the federal department in the United States that sets and maintains foreign policies

examples.en: Vintage computing enthusiasts still enjoy running legacy games on the original DOS.
examples.zh: 老式电脑爱好者仍然喜欢在最初的DOS系统上运行经典游戏。

lemmas.def_en: someone who sleeps in any convenient place

family_guide.root_logic: 以 doss 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: occurring or payable twice each year

examples.en: The scientific society hosts a popular biannual conference for international climate researchers.
examples.zh: 该科学协会为国际气候研究人员举办备受关注的一年两次的会议。

lemmas.def_en: twice a year

examples.en: we hold our big sale biannually

family_guide.root_logic: 以 biannual 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 用嘴整理, 打扮, 使得意；打扮漂亮, 感到得意
lemmas.def_en: clean with one's bill

examples.en: The elegant swan paused near the riverbank to preen its white feathers.
examples.zh: 优雅的天鹅在河岸边停下，整理它洁白的羽毛。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 preen 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 技术专家治国论者, 技术专家统治论者
lemmas.def_en: an expert who is a member of a highly skilled elite group

examples.en: The new finance minister is a pragmatic technocrat who avoids partisan politics.
examples.zh: 新任财政部长是一位回避党派政治的务实技术专家官员。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 technocrat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 一束, 飞鸟群, 纠纷
lemmas.def_en: coils of worsted yarn

examples.en: She bought a thick skein of soft wool to knit a winter scarf.
examples.zh: 她买了一束厚实的软羊毛线来织一条冬日围巾。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 skein 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a written message addressed to a person or organization

examples.en: The ambassador received a formal diplomatic missive from the foreign minister yesterday.
examples.zh: 大使昨天收到了来自外交部长的正式外交公文。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 missive 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 弯弯曲曲的, 迂回的, 运动柔软的
lemmas.def_en: curved or curving in and out

examples.en: The sinuous mountain trail offered breathtaking views at every sharp, unexpected turn.
examples.zh: 蜿蜒的山间小道在每个急转弯处都呈现出惊人的美景。

lemmas.def_zh: 蜿蜒地, 弯曲地；拐弯抹角地；错综复杂地
lemmas.def_en: in a sinuous manner

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sinuous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: mutual accusations

examples.en: The meeting dissolved into bitter recrimination instead of focusing on viable practical solutions.
examples.zh: 会议陷入了激烈的互相指责，未能专注于切实可行的方案。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 recrimination 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 快马, 跳舞者, (美)(非正式)花很多时间参加社交活动的学生
lemmas.def_en: a professional dancer

examples.en: She works out on the stepper every morning to build lower body strength.
examples.zh: 她每天早上在踏步机上锻炼，以增强下肢力量。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stepper 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: small donkey used as a pack animal

examples.en: A sturdy burro carried their heavy camping gear up the steep rocky canyon.
examples.zh: 一头健壮的小驴驮着他们沉重的露营装备爬上了陡峭的岩石峡谷。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 burro 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a young child

examples.en: The proud grandmother gently rocked the sleeping bambino in her warm arms.
examples.zh: 那位自豪的祖母在她温暖的怀抱中轻轻摇晃着熟睡的婴儿。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bambino 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 金刚鹦鹉, 芳香核果棕榈
lemmas.def_en: long-tailed brilliantly colored parrot of Central America and South America; among the largest and showiest of parrots

examples.en: A colorful macaw perched on the branch and squawked loudly at the visitors.
examples.zh: 一只色彩斑斓的金刚鹦鹉栖息在树枝上，朝游客们大声鸣叫。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 macaw 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a surface whose plane sections are all ellipses or circles

examples.en: Astronomers discovered that the rapidly spinning dwarf planet is actually a smooth ellipsoid.
examples.zh: 天文学家发现，这颗快速自转的矮行星实际上是一个光滑的椭圆体。

lemmas.def_en: having the nature or shape of an ellipsoid

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ellipsoid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a small sphere of camphor or naphthalene used to keep moths away from stored clothing

examples.en: The old wooden wardrobe smelled strongly of cedar chips and pungent mothballs.
examples.zh: 这个旧木质衣柜里弥漫着雪松木屑和刺鼻樟脑丸的浓重气味。

lemmas.def_en: put into long-term storage

examples.en: The old wooden wardrobe smelled strongly of cedar chips and pungent mothballs.
examples.zh: 这个旧木质衣柜里弥漫着雪松木屑和刺鼻樟脑丸的浓重气味。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mothball 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 闲谈, 谈论, 泄露秘密；泄露
lemmas.def_en: speak (about unimportant matters) rapidly and incessantly

examples.en: The little boy threatened to tattle to the teacher after his classmate pushed him.
examples.zh: 小男孩在被同学推搡后，威胁说要向老师告状。

lemmas.def_zh: 说闲话的人, 饶舌, 说长道短的人
lemmas.def_en: someone who gossips indiscreetly

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tattle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: someone who writes scripts for plays or movies or broadcast dramas

examples.en: The talented scriptwriter spent months revising the dialogue for the upcoming feature film.
examples.zh: 这位才华横溢的编剧花了数月时间为即将上映的故事片修改对白。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scriptwriter 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: cross the road at a red light

examples.en: Police officers warned tourists not to jaywalk across the busy downtown avenue.
examples.zh: 警官警告游客不要乱穿车流繁忙的市中心大道。

lemmas.def_en: a reckless pedestrian who crosses a street illegally

family_guide.root_logic: 以 jaywalk 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the application of mathematics and statistics to the study of economic and financial data

examples.en: She uses advanced econometrics to forecast consumer spending patterns during economic downturns.
examples.zh: 她利用高级计量经济学来预测经济低迷时期的消费者支出模式。

lemmas.def_en: an economist who uses statistical and mathematical methods
of or relating to econometrics

examples.en: The researchers developed an econometric model to forecast inflation trends for the upcoming year.
examples.zh: 研究人员开发了一个计量经济学模型来预测来年的通胀趋势。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 econometrics 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: undergo hydrolysis; decompose by reacting with water

examples.en: Special enzymes in the stomach help to hydrolyze complex proteins into essential amino acids.
examples.zh: 胃里的特殊酶有助于将复杂蛋白质水解为必需氨基酸。

lemmas.def_en: capable of undergoing hydrolysis

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hydrolyze 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (使)异种交配, (使)混种, (使)杂种繁殖
lemmas.def_en: breed animals or plants using parents of different races and varieties

examples.en: The two isolated bird species rarely interbreed in nature due to different mating calls.
examples.zh: 由于求偶叫声不同，这两个孤立的鸟类物种在自然界中极少杂交。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 interbreed 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 闯入者, 好事者, 无执照营业者
lemmas.def_en: someone who intrudes on the privacy or property of another without permission

examples.en: The stray cat hissed fiercely at the interloper trying to enter its territory.
examples.zh: 这只流浪猫对着试图进入其领地的闯入者发出凶狠的嘶嘶声。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 interloper 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 白帽队队员, 浪端的白泡沫
lemmas.def_en: a wave that is blown by the wind so its crest is broken and appears white

examples.en: Strong coastal winds churned the dark sea, creating frothy whitecaps across the bay.
examples.zh: 强烈的沿海风掀翻了阴沉的海水，在整个海湾泛起白色的浪花。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 whitecap 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 包抄, 迂回, 智胜
lemmas.def_en: go around the flank of (an opposing army)

examples.en: The agile startup managed to outflank its larger competitors through rapid technological innovation.
examples.zh: 这家敏捷的初创公司通过快速的技术创新成功智胜了规模更大的竞争对手。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 outflank 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: more active than normal

examples.en: His overactive imagination kept him awake at night thinking about mysterious noises downstairs.
examples.zh: 他过度活跃的想象力让他彻夜难眠，总琢磨着楼下的奇怪声响。

lemmas.def_zh: 活动过度, 过度活跃
lemmas.def_en: excessive activity

examples.en: overactivity of the sebaceous glands causes the skin to become oily

family_guide.root_logic: 以 overactive 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the vegetative part of a fungus consisting of a mass of branching threadlike hyphae

examples.en: The dense underground mycelium absorbed moisture and shared vital nutrients with nearby trees.
examples.zh: 致密的地下菌丝体吸收水分，并与附近的树木共享重要养分。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mycelium 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: one millionth (10^-6) of a second; one thousandth of a millisecond

examples.en: The advanced camera shutter can capture high-speed motion in just a single microsecond.
examples.zh: 这种先进的相机快门仅需一微秒就能捕捉高速运动。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 microsecond 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a resident of a town or city

examples.en: As a lifelong towner, he preferred bustling sidewalks over quiet and empty country roads.
examples.zh: 作为终身城镇居民，相比安静空旷的乡间小路，他更喜欢热闹的人行道。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 towner 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 弄皱, 弄得乱七八糟
lemmas.def_en: disturb the smoothness of

examples.en: Sitting in the cramped airplane seat for hours will inevitably rumple your crisp shirt.
examples.zh: 在狭窄的飞机座位上坐几个小时，难免会弄皱你平整的衬衫。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rumple 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: ride standing on a surfboard with an attached sail, on water

examples.en: They often windsurf across the sunny bay when the afternoon breeze picks up.
examples.zh: 当下战书的微风渐起时，他们经常在阳光普照的海湾中进行帆板冲浪。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 windsurf 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: saw used with one hand for cutting metal

examples.en: He used a sharp hacksaw to cut through the rusted metal pipe smoothly.
examples.zh: 他用一把锋利的钢锯平整地锯断了那根生锈的金属管道。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hacksaw 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: someone who guards prisoners

examples.en: The stern turnkey locked the heavy iron cell door before walking away slowly.
examples.zh: 严厉的狱吏锁上沉重的铁牢门后缓缓走开了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 turnkey 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: with the head foremost

examples.en: He made a reckless headfirst dive into the shallow lake and injured his shoulder.
examples.zh: 他鲁莽地头朝下扎进浅湖里，伤到了肩膀。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 headfirst 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a midday meal

examples.en: Office workers in the city gathered on the lawn to enjoy their packed tiffin.
examples.zh: 城里的上班族聚集在草坪上享用各自打包的午餐。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tiffin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of something having a dusky brownish grey color

examples.en: She repainted the living room walls in a soft taupe shade to feel warmer.
examples.zh: 她把客厅墙壁重新粉刷成柔和的灰褐色，以营造温馨感。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 taupe 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 在其上, 关于那, 因此, 由此, 随即, 于是, 立即

examples.en: The committee reviewed the final petition, and thereupon decided to grant the requested permit.
examples.zh: 委员会审查了最终请愿书，随即决定发放所需的许可证。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 thereupon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 攻不破的, 不容置疑的, 无懈可击的
lemmas.def_en: immune to attack; incapable of being tampered with

examples.en: Her defense was built on documented facts, making her legal position entirely unassailable.
examples.zh: 她的辩护建立在有据可查的事实之上，法律立场无懈可击。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 unassailable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any plant of the genus Stevia or the closely related genus Piqueria having glutinous foliage and white or purplish flowers; Central and South America

examples.en: He preferred sweetening his morning black coffee with natural stevia rather than white sugar.
examples.zh: 他更喜欢用天然甜叶菊代替白糖来给早晨的黑咖啡增甜。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stevia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 波美拉尼亚丝毛狗（一种尖嘴竖耳的光滑毛小狗）
lemmas.def_en: any of various stocky heavy-coated breeds of dogs native to northern regions having pointed muzzles and erect ears with a curled furry tail

examples.en: A white spitz bounded across the lawn, barking merrily at the incoming guests.
examples.zh: 一只白色的波美拉尼亚丝毛狗欢快地穿过草坪，朝着来访的客人吠叫。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 spitz 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 一团槽的, 大混乱的
lemmas.def_en: snarled or stalled in complete confusion

examples.en: The airport experienced a totally snafu situation after the central radar network abruptly crashed.
examples.zh: 在中央雷达网络突然瘫痪后，机场陷入了一片混乱的局面。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 snafu 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: make a clucking sounds, characteristic of hens

examples.en: The brood hen began to cluck loudly when a stray cat approached the coop.
examples.zh: 当一只野猫靠近鸡舍时，母鸡开始大声咯咯叫。

lemmas.def_en: the sound made by a hen (as in calling her chicks)

examples.en: The brood hen began to cluck loudly when a stray cat approached the coop.
examples.zh: 当一只野猫靠近鸡舍时，母鸡开始大声咯咯叫。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cluck 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a broadcast that is carried simultaneously by radio and television (or by FM and AM radio)

examples.en: Millions of sports fans watched the live simulcast of the final championship game.
examples.zh: 数百万体育迷观看了这场最终冠军争夺战的现场联播。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 simulcast 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 文氏管, 文丘里管( 一种流体流量测定装置, 亦作venturitube)
lemmas.def_en: United States architect (born in 1925)

examples.en: The mechanic inspected the dirty venturi to ensure air mixed properly with the fuel.
examples.zh: 机械师检查了肮脏的文丘里管，以确保空气与燃料正常混合。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 venturi 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: framework that serves as a support for the body of a vehicle

examples.en: A warning light flashed on the dashboard when the plane's undercarriage failed to deploy.
examples.zh: 当飞机的起落架未能展开时，仪表盘上的警示灯闪烁起来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 undercarriage 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不受妨碍的, 不受阻碍的
lemmas.def_en: not slowed or blocked or interfered with

examples.en: The small sailing boat drifted unhindered down the calm river under the moonlight.
examples.zh: 在月光下，小帆船畅通无阻地沿着平静的河流缓缓漂流。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 unhindered 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 未经审问的, 未经调查的, 无异议的, 不被怀疑的
lemmas.def_en: generally agreed upon; not subject to dispute

examples.en: His unquestioned integrity made him the obvious candidate to lead the internal ethics investigation.
examples.zh: 他那无可置疑的正直品质使他成为领导内部道德调查的最佳人选。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 unquestioned 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: untanned hide especially of cattle; cut in strips it is used for whips and ropes

examples.en: The rancher carefully braided strips of tough rawhide into a very sturdy cattle whip.
examples.zh: 牧场主小心地将坚韧的生皮条编织成一条非常结实的牛鞭。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rawhide 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 只在地球上的, 只在地面的, 只在陆地的, 世俗的, 平凡的, 缺乏想象力的
lemmas.def_en: confined to the earth

examples.en: The heavy summer storm kept the small private airplanes earthbound for two whole days.
examples.zh: 猛烈的夏季风暴使那些小型私人飞机在地面整整停飞了两天。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 earthbound 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: favoritism shown to friends and associates (as by appointing them to positions without regard for their qualifications)

examples.en: The mayor was widely criticized for rampant cronyism after appointing several unqualified close friends.
examples.zh: 市长因任命数名不合格的亲密好友而受到任人唯亲的广泛批评。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cronyism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 多岩的, 崎岖的, 峻峭的, 多峭壁的
lemmas.def_en: having hills and crags

examples.en: Hikers carefully navigated the craggy mountain path as the morning mist began clearing.
examples.zh: 当晨雾开始散去时，徒步者们小心翼翼地穿行在崎岖多岩的山间小径上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 craggy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 冠, 小冠冕, 冠状头饰
lemmas.def_en: a small crown; usually indicates a high rank but below that of sovereign

examples.en: The noble duchess wore a delicate pearl coronet during the grand royal celebration.
examples.zh: 高贵的公爵夫人在盛大的皇家庆典上佩戴了一顶精致的珍珠小冠冕。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 coronet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a man who drives a coach (or carriage)

examples.en: The faithful coachman held the reins tight as the horses approached the mansion gates.
examples.zh: 当马匹接近庄园大门时，忠诚的马车夫紧紧拉住了缰绳。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 coachman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a milk protein used in making e.g. plastics and adhesives

examples.en: Athletes often consume slowly digested casein protein powder right before going to sleep.
examples.zh: 运动员经常在入睡前摄入消化缓慢的酪蛋白粉。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 casein 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a clear seasoned broth

examples.en: She sipped a warm cup of bouillon to soothe her sore throat.
examples.zh: 她喝了一小碗温热的清汤来缓解喉咙痛。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bouillon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 蜡防印花法, 蜡防印花布
lemmas.def_en: a dyed fabric; a removable wax is used where the dye is not wanted

examples.en: The artisan used melted wax to create intricate patterns on the batik fabric.
examples.zh: 工匠用熔化的蜡在蜡染布上制作出复杂的图案。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 batik 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 防卫器官, 盔甲, 电枢, 电缆的铠装
lemmas.def_en: coil in which voltage is induced by motion through a magnetic field

examples.en: The technician carefully repaired the damaged armature inside the broken electric motor.
examples.zh: 技术人员仔细修理了损坏的电动机内部电枢。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 armature 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a metallic element having four allotropic forms; used in a wide variety of alloys; found in stibnite

examples.en: The factory uses antimony as a key hardening agent in lead alloys.
examples.zh: 该工厂使用锑作为铅合金的关键硬化剂。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 antimony 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 病后的照顾调养, 释放后的安置
lemmas.def_en: care and treatment of a convalescent patient

examples.en: Proper aftercare is essential for patients recovering from major heart surgery.
examples.zh: 术后良好的调养对于心脏大手术康复期的患者至关重要。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 aftercare 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a cocktail made of orange liqueur with lemon juice and brandy

examples.en: He took his dog for an exciting ride in the vintage motorcycle sidecar.
examples.zh: 他带着他的狗坐在老式摩托车的边车里兜风。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sidecar 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: bandage that stops the flow of blood from an artery by applying pressure

examples.en: The paramedic applied a tight tourniquet to stop the victim's severe bleeding.
examples.zh: 医护人员扎紧了止血带，以阻止伤者的严重出血。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tourniquet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 乐意的, 想要的, 愿意的, 不得不
lemmas.def_en: having made preparations

examples.en: Facing severe winter storms, the travelers were fain to seek nearby shelter.
examples.zh: 面对凛冽的冬日暴风雪，旅客们不得不寻找附近的避难所。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fain 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the muscular system of an organism

examples.en: Years of intense swimming developed the athlete's impressive back musculature.
examples.zh: 多年高强度的游泳训练造就了该运动员发达的背部肌肉群。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 musculature 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 金属加工术, 金属工
lemmas.def_en: the activity of making things out of metal in a skillful manner

examples.en: He mastered traditional metalworking techniques while apprenticing at a local blacksmith shop.
examples.zh: 他在当地一家铁匠铺当学徒时掌握了传统金属加工技术。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 metalworking 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of being luminous; emitting or reflecting light

examples.en: The new computer monitor offers higher luminance for better visibility in sunlight.
examples.zh: 这款新电脑显示器具有更高的亮度，在阳光下看得更清楚。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 luminance 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a large continuous extent of land

examples.en: Millions of years ago, a single giant landmass covered part of Earth.
examples.zh: 数百万年前，一个巨大的单一块陆地覆盖了地球的部分区域。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 landmass 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: small round bright-colored and spotted beetle that usually feeds on aphids and other insect pests

examples.en: A colorful ladybird landed gently on the green leaf in my garden.
examples.zh: 一只色彩鲜艳的瓢虫轻轻落在我花园的绿叶上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ladybird 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [化] 可乐果; 可乐果属; 可乐果干子叶
lemmas.def_en: tree bearing large brown nuts containing e.g. caffeine; source of cola extract

examples.en: Traditional beverages often used extracts from the kola nut for natural caffeine.
examples.zh: 传统饮料通常使用可乐果提取物来获取天然咖啡因。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kola 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 克朗代克河(在加拿大西北部,育空河的支流)
lemmas.def_en: a region in northwestern Canada where gold was discovered in 1896 but exhausted by 1910

examples.en: Thousands of hopeful prospectors rushed to the Klondike region seeking gold.
examples.zh: 成千上万心怀希望的淘金者涌向克朗代克地区寻找黄金。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 klondike 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: large brownish-green New Zealand parrot

examples.en: The curious kea used its sharp beak to inspect our hiking backpacks.
examples.zh: 那只好奇的啄羊鹦鹉用锋利的喙检查我们的徒步背包。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kea 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: affecting the mind or mood or other mental processes

examples.en: The doctor prescribed a mild psychotropic medication to treat his severe anxiety.
examples.zh: 医生开了一种温和的精神类药物来治疗他严重的焦虑症。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 psychotropic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a restricted computer network; a private network created using World Wide Web software

examples.en: Employees can download the updated policy documents directly from the company intranet.
examples.zh: 员工可以直接从公司内部网下载最新的政策文件。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 intranet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: internal organs collectively (especially those in the abdominal cavity)

examples.en: The mechanic removed the machine's casing to examine its complex mechanical innards.
examples.zh: 机械师拆下了机器外壳，以检查其复杂的内部机械结构。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 innards 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 起初的, 发端的, 初期的
lemmas.def_en: only partly in existence; imperfectly formed

examples.en: Early treatment helped cure the patient's incipient infection before it spread further.
examples.zh: 早期治疗帮助该患者在初起感染进一步扩散前将其治愈。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 incipient 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a sponsor who books and stages public entertainments

examples.en: The famous impresario successfully organized a world tour for the talented young orchestra.
examples.zh: 这位著名的演艺经纪人成功为这支才华横溢的年轻乐团组织了世界巡演。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 impresario 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a craft capable of moving over water or land on a cushion of air created by jet engines

examples.en: The rescue team used a hovercraft to travel across the muddy marshland.
examples.zh: 救援队使用气垫船穿越泥泞的沼泽地。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hovercraft 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a classroom in which all students in a particular grade (or in a division of a grade) meet at certain times under the supervision of a teacher who takes attendance and does other administrative business

examples.en: Students must gather in their homeroom each morning for attendance and announcements.
examples.zh: 学生们每天早晨必须在班主任辅导教室集合点名并听取通知。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 homeroom 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of a building having more than one level

examples.en: The new shopping mall features a spacious multilevel parking garage for visitors.
examples.zh: 新购物中心为顾客配备了一个宽敞的多层停车场。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 multilevel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 进步党主义, 进步人士的政见, 进步教育理论
lemmas.def_en: the political orientation of those who favor progress toward better conditions in government and society

examples.en: His political philosophy is deeply rooted in early twentieth-century progressivism.
examples.zh: 他的政治哲学深深植根于20世纪初的进步主义。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 progressivism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a grant that funds postdoctoral study or research

examples.en: After defending her dissertation, she accepted a postdoc at Harvard.
examples.zh: 论文答辩通过后，她在哈佛大学接受了一份博士后研究职位。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 postdoc 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: flesh of a saltwater fish similar to sea bass

examples.en: The chef prepared a delicious grilled grouper seasoned with fresh herbs.
examples.zh: 大厨用新鲜香草烹制了一道美味的烤石斑鱼。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 grouper 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 婚礼; 婚礼( nuptial的名词复数 )
lemmas.def_en: the social event at which the ceremony of marriage is performed

examples.en: The happy couple celebrated their nuptials with close friends and family.
examples.zh: 这对幸福的新人与密友和家人一起庆祝了他们的婚礼。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nuptials 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 身心的, 身心失调的
lemmas.def_en: used of illness or symptoms resulting from neurosis

examples.en: Doctors concluded that his chronic stomach pain was largely psychosomatic.
examples.zh: 医生们得出结论，他的慢性胃痛在很大程度上是身心失调引起的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 psychosomatic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: done by hand without mechanical aids or devices

examples.en: The artist drew a stunning portrait freehand in just ten minutes.
examples.zh: 这位艺术家仅用十分钟就徒手绘制了一幅令人惊叹的肖像。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 freehand 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: whatever happens to be available especially when offered to an unexpected guest or when brought by guests and shared by all

examples.en: Everyone brought a homemade dish to share at the neighborhood potluck.
examples.zh: 每个人都带了一道家常菜在邻里百家餐上分享。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 potluck 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 肉片, 炸肉片, 炸肉排
lemmas.def_en: thin slice of meat (especially veal) usually fried or broiled

examples.en: He ordered a breaded pork cutlet served with mashed potatoes.
examples.zh: 他点了一份裹着面包糠、配有土豆泥的炸猪排。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cutlet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: informal terms for a human head

examples.en: He bumped his noggin on the low ceiling of the cellar.
examples.zh: 他在地窖的低矮天花板上撞到了头。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 noggin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: machine consisting of a heavy bar that moves vertically for pounding or crushing ores

examples.en: She used a mortar and pestle to crush the aromatic spices.
examples.zh: 她用研钵和研杵捣碎了那些芳香的香料。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pestle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 光度学的, 光度计的, 光度测定的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to photometry

examples.en: Astronomers used photometric analysis to measure the distant star's brightness.
examples.zh: 天文学家利用光度测定分析测量了那颗遥远恒星的亮度。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 photometric 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 多角形的, 多边形的
lemmas.def_en: having many sides or relating to a surface marked by polygons

examples.en: The courtyard was paved with unique polygonal stones of varying sizes.
examples.zh: 庭院铺着大小不一的独特多边形石块。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 polygonal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a woman policeman

examples.en: The policewoman directed traffic smoothly through the busy downtown intersection.
examples.zh: 女警察在繁忙的市中心十字路口顺畅地指挥交通。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 policewoman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a technician who designs or maintains a website

examples.en: Please contact the webmaster if you experience issues loading this page.
examples.zh: 如果加载此页面时遇到问题，请联系网站管理员。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 webmaster 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: wear away by rubbing

examples.en: A week of endless meetings began to frazzle her nerves completely.
examples.zh: 一周无休止的会议彻底把她的神经搞崩溃了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 frazzle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an informal use of the Latin word for father; sometimes used by British schoolboys or used facetiously

examples.en: He inherited the large country estate following the death of his pater.
examples.zh: 父亲去世后，他继承了那座庞大的乡村庄园。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pater 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 灵巧的, 敏捷的, 聪明的
lemmas.def_en: quick or skillful or adept in action or thought

examples.en: Thanks to her adroit negotiation skills, the deal was closed quickly.
examples.zh: 多亏了她熟练老练的谈判技巧，交易很快就达成了。

lemmas.def_en: with adroitness; in an adroit manner

examples.en: he handled the situation adroitly

lemmas.def_en: skillful performance or ability without difficulty

examples.en: his quick adeptness was a product of good design
he was famous for his facility as an archer

family_guide.root_logic: 以 adroit 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: chewy cookie usually containing almond paste

examples.en: She enjoyed a sweet coconut macaroon alongside her afternoon cup of tea.
examples.zh: 她一边喝下午茶，一边享用着香甜的椰蓉蛋白杏仁饼干。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 macaroon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a group of biological taxa or species that share features inherited from a common ancestor

examples.en: Birds and modern reptiles belong to the same evolutionary clade.
examples.zh: 鸟类和现代爬行动物属于同一个进化枝。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 clade 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: driven by lust; preoccupied with or exhibiting lustful desires

examples.en: He was dismissed from his post for making repeatedly lascivious remarks.
examples.zh: 他因屡次发表下流好色的言论而被免职。

lemmas.def_en: feeling morbid sexual desire or a propensity to lewdness
in a lascivious manner

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lascivious 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a behavioral attribute that is distinctive and peculiar to an individual

examples.en: We all tolerated his harmless foibles because he was genuinely kind.
examples.zh: 我们都包容他那些无伤大雅的小毛病，因为他真的很善良。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 foible 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 感情横溢的, 奔放的, 流出的
lemmas.def_en: uttered with unrestrained enthusiasm

examples.en: The host gave an effusive welcome to all the arriving guests.
examples.zh: 主人对所有到来的宾客表达了极为热情的欢迎。

lemmas.def_zh: 变溢地, 热情洋溢地
lemmas.def_en: in an effusive manner

examples.en: the critics praised her effusively

family_guide.root_logic: 以 effusive 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 酒宴的, 欢宴的, 欢乐的
lemmas.def_en: occupied with or fond of the pleasures of good company

examples.en: The pub provided a convivial atmosphere where travelers could easily mingle.
examples.zh: 这家酒吧提供了欢乐融洽的氛围，旅行者们很容易打成一片。

lemmas.def_zh: 欢宴, 欢乐, 高兴
lemmas.def_en: a jovial nature

family_guide.root_logic: 以 convivial 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a cowboy of the South American pampas

examples.en: The experienced gaucho rode across the vast pampa to herd the stray cattle.
examples.zh: 经验丰富的潘帕斯牧民骑马穿过辽阔的草原去围赶走失的牲畜。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gaucho 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the inner sole of a shoe or boot where the foot rests

examples.en: A cushioned insole can significantly reduce foot pain during long daily walks.
examples.zh: 一副有缓冲作用的鞋垫能显著减轻日常长途步行时的脚痛。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 insole 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 厚厚地涂, 大量使用
lemmas.def_en: spread thickly

examples.en: Remember to slather plenty of sunscreen on your shoulders before heading outside.
examples.zh: 出门前记得在肩膀上厚厚地涂上一层防晒霜。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 slather 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 幼虫食叶子的蛾类,搜集鸡蛋的人
lemmas.def_en: moth having nonfunctional mouthparts as adults; larvae feed on tree foliage and spin egg-shaped cocoons

examples.en: The collector carefully preserved the rare egger moth inside a glass display case.
examples.zh: 收藏家把那只罕见的枯叶蛾仔细地保存在玻璃陈列盒里。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 egger 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a citizen of an English borough

examples.en: The wealthy burgher contributed a large sum to rebuild the historic town hall.
examples.zh: 这位富有的市民捐了一大笔钱用于重建历史悠久的市政厅。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 burgher 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 冲洗, 痛饮；大口地喝, 冲刷
lemmas.def_en: feed pigs

examples.en: After a hard day at work, they went to swill beer at the pub.
examples.zh: 结束一天辛苦的工作后，他们去酒吧痛饮啤酒。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 swill 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the branch of psychology concerned with abnormal behavior

examples.en: Her groundbreaking research explored the psychopathology of severe chronic mood disorders.
examples.zh: 她的开创性研究探索了严重慢性心境障碍的精神病理学。

lemmas.def_en: suffering from an undiagnosed mental disorder

family_guide.root_logic: 以 psychopathology 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 集邮, 集邮的兴趣, 集邮者(总称)
lemmas.def_en: the collection and study of postage stamps

examples.en: He inherited an interest in philately from his grandfather and collected rare stamps.
examples.zh: 他从祖父那里继承了对集邮的兴趣，并收藏罕见的邮票。

lemmas.def_en: a collector and student of postage stamps

lemmas.def_zh: 集邮的, 集邮癖的, 有集邮价值的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to philately or of interest to philatelists

family_guide.root_logic: 以 philately 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 易变的, 性情不定的
lemmas.def_en: capable of or tending to change in form or quality or nature

examples.en: Public opinion on this controversial topic remains remarkably mutable and unpredictable.
examples.zh: 公众对这个有争议话题的看法仍然极易变化且难以预测。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of being capable of mutation

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mutable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 星形[胶质]细胞, 蛛形细胞
lemmas.def_en: comparatively large neuroglial cell

examples.en: Each astrocyte in the brain plays a critical role in supporting nearby neurons.
examples.zh: 大脑中的每个星形胶质细胞在支持邻近神经元方面都起着关键作用。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or containing large star-shaped cells in the neuroglia

family_guide.root_logic: 以 astrocyte 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 为供神而宰杀, 牺牲, 杀死
lemmas.def_en: offer as a sacrifice by killing or by giving up to destruction

examples.en: The monk chose to immolate himself in the town square as a political protest.
examples.zh: 那名僧人选择在城镇广场自焚，以此进行政治抗议。

lemmas.def_zh: 宰杀, 献身, 祭物
lemmas.def_en: killing or offering as a sacrifice

family_guide.root_logic: 以 immolate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: go away from the surface to which (a substance) is adsorbed

examples.en: Heating the sample causes the trapped chemical gas to rapidly desorb from the surface.
examples.zh: 加热样品会导致吸附的化学气体迅速从表面解吸出来。

lemmas.def_en: changing from an adsorbed state on a surface to a gaseous or liquid state

family_guide.root_logic: 以 desorb 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: assistance in time of difficulty

examples.en: The local charity provided food and succor to the flood victims in need.
examples.zh: 当地慈善机构为急需帮助的洪灾受害者提供了食物和救助。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 succor 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a person who advocates war or warlike policies

examples.en: The radical politician was widely condemned by the public as a dangerous warmonger.
examples.zh: 这位激进的政客被公众普遍谴责为危险的战争贩子。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 warmonger 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the branch of medicine concerned with the feet

examples.en: She decided to study podiatry to treat patients suffering from chronic foot ailments.
examples.zh: 她决定攻读足病学，以治疗患有慢性足部疾病的患者。

lemmas.def_en: a specialist in care for the feet

family_guide.root_logic: 以 podiatry 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 射线照片, 射线照相
lemmas.def_en: a photographic image produced on a radiosensitive surface by radiation other than visible light (especially by X-rays or gamma rays)

examples.en: The dental radiograph clearly revealed a small hidden cavity beneath the patient's crown.
examples.zh: 牙科X光照片清晰地显示了患者牙冠下方一处隐蔽的小蛀洞。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 radiograph 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 如锁链般连接, 使连锁, 连结
lemmas.def_en: combine two strings to form a single one

examples.en: You can easily concatenate the two separate text files using this simple script.
examples.zh: 你可以使用这个简单的脚本轻松地将两个独立的文本文件连接起来。

lemmas.def_zh: 串联, 连结, 一系列相互联系的事物
lemmas.def_en: the state of being linked together as in a chain; union in a linked series

family_guide.root_logic: 以 concatenate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 献酒, 奠酒, 饮酒
lemmas.def_en: (facetious) a serving of an alcoholic beverage

examples.en: The ancient priest poured a libation of wine onto the stone altar at dawn.
examples.zh: 破晓时分，古代祭司在石坛上倾倒葡萄酒以行奠酒礼。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 libation 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a sudden loss of consciousness resulting when the rupture or occlusion of a blood vessel leads to oxygen lack in the brain

examples.en: The old merchant suffered an attack of apoplexy and was rushed to the hospital.
examples.zh: 那位老商人突发中风，被紧急送往了医院。

lemmas.def_zh: 中风的, 有中风迹象的
lemmas.def_en: pertaining to or characteristic of apoplexy

examples.en: apoplectic seizure

family_guide.root_logic: 以 apoplexy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a person who is regarded as eccentric or mad

examples.en: Some wacko on the subway was shouting loudly at completely imaginary passengers yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天地铁里有个怪人对着完全虚构的乘客大喊大叫。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wacko 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 唠叨, 空谈, 瞎扯
lemmas.def_en: idle or foolish and irrelevant talk

examples.en: She had grown very tired of his endless prate about minor office politics.
examples.zh: 她对他没完没了地唠叨办公室琐碎政治感到非常厌烦。

lemmas.def_en: an obnoxious and foolish and loquacious talker
speak (about unimportant matters) rapidly and incessantly

examples.en: She had grown very tired of his endless prate about minor office politics.
examples.zh: 她对他没完没了地唠叨办公室琐碎政治感到非常厌烦。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 prate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (linguistics) a large group of languages that are historically related

examples.en: Biologists classified the newly discovered deep-sea creature into an existing marine phylum.
examples.zh: 生物学家将这种新发现的深海生物归入了一个现有的海洋门。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 phylum 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a white hard metallic element that is one of the platinum group and is found in platinum ores; used in alloys with platinum

examples.en: Rhodium is one of the rarest and most valuable precious metals available.
examples.zh: 铑是现存最稀有、最珍贵的贵金属之一。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rhodium 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 大吃一惊的, 目瞪口呆的
lemmas.def_en: utterly astounded

examples.en: I was completely gobsmacked when they announced that our team won first place.
examples.zh: 当他们宣布我们队获得第一名时，我完全惊呆了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gobsmacked 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 丧失名誉, 坏名声, 不名誉
lemmas.def_en: the state of being held in low esteem

examples.en: The recent corruption scandal has brought the entire financial firm into serious disrepute.
examples.zh: 最近的腐败丑闻使整家金融公司声名狼藉。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 disrepute 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a thick mush made of cornmeal boiled in stock or water

examples.en: She served the tender braised beef over a warm bed of creamy polenta.
examples.zh: 她把炖得软烂的牛肉盛在温热绵密的玉米糊上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 polenta 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: beef or chicken or seafood marinated in spicy soy sauce and grilled or broiled

examples.en: We ordered grilled chicken teriyaki served with steamed rice and seasonal vegetables.
examples.zh: 我们点了配有米饭和时令蔬菜的照烧烤鸡肉。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 teriyaki 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (American football) a play in which one player hands the ball to a teammate

examples.en: The quarterback executed a clean handoff to the running back for a touchdown.
examples.zh: 四分卫干净利落地把球递传给跑卫，完成了一次达阵。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 handoff 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the fifth pillar of Islam is a pilgrimage to Mecca during the month of Dhu al-Hijja; at least once in a lifetime a Muslim is expected to make a religious journey to Mecca and the Kaaba

examples.en: Millions of devoted Muslims travel to Mecca each year to perform the holy haj.
examples.zh: 每年有数百万虔诚的穆斯林前往麦加进行神圣的朝觐。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 haj 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 女妖, 魔鬼, 妓女
lemmas.def_en: a female demon believed to have sexual intercourse with sleeping men

examples.en: Medieval folklore warned sleeping men about the deceptive and dangerous nocturnal succubus.
examples.zh: 中世纪的民间传说告诫沉睡中的男人们警惕危险而具欺骗性的夜间女妖。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 succubus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 肿胀的, 静脉曲张的
lemmas.def_en: abnormally swollen or knotty

examples.en: Standing on hard floors all day contributed to the painful varicose veins in her legs.
examples.zh: 整天站在坚硬的地板上导致她腿部出现了痛苦的静脉曲张。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 varicose 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [复]n.(面粉或马铃薯做的)汤团,团子
lemmas.def_en: (Italian) a small dumpling made of potato or flour or semolina that is boiled or baked and is usually served with a sauce or with grated cheese

examples.en: The chef prepared homemade potato gnocchi tossed in a fragrant sage and butter sauce.
examples.zh: 厨师制作了拌有香浓鼠尾草黄油酱的自制土豆团子。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gnocchi 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 缺乏社经验的, 笨拙的, 粗鲁的, 无礼的, 偏转的
lemmas.def_en: lacking social polish

examples.en: His gauche behavior at the formal dinner embarrassed everyone seated around the table.
examples.zh: 他在正式晚宴上的笨拙举止让同桌的所有人都感到尴尬。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gauche 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a covering material made of glass fibers in resins

examples.en: Modern boat hulls are often constructed from durable fibreglass to withstand rough waves.
examples.zh: 现代船体通常由耐用的玻璃纤维制成，以抵御汹涌的风浪。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fibreglass 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 意大利熏火腿(切成薄片, 常与甜瓜或无花果配成一道菜)
lemmas.def_en: Italian salt-cured ham usually sliced paper thin

examples.en: We enjoyed a classic Italian appetizer of sweet melon wrapped in thinly sliced prosciutto.
examples.zh: 我们享用了一道裹着薄切意大利熏火腿的甜甜瓜经典意式开胃菜。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 prosciutto 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a long backless sofa (usually with pillows against a wall)

examples.en: He rested comfortably on the plush divan while reading a novel by the window.
examples.zh: 他舒服地靠在靠窗的豪华长沙发上看小说。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 divan 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: relating to fluids at rest or to the pressures they exert or transmit

examples.en: Engineers carefully calculated the hydrostatic pressure exerted on the base of the deep dam.
examples.zh: 工程师们仔细计算了深坝底部承受的流体静压力。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hydrostatic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: frozen dessert containing cream and sugar and flavoring

examples.en: The children eagerly ate bowls of chocolate icecream on a hot summer afternoon.
examples.zh: 炎热的夏日午后，孩子们热切地吃着几碗巧克力冰淇淋。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 icecream 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 一阵一阵痛, 刺痛, 剧痛
lemmas.def_en: a sudden sharp feeling

examples.en: He felt a sudden, sharp twinge of pain in his knee after sprinting.
examples.zh: 冲刺跑后，他的膝盖突然感到一阵剧烈的刺痛。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 twinge 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (意大利烹饪用的含西红柿、大蒜、洋葱等调制成的)海员式沙司
lemmas.def_en: sauce for pasta; contains tomatoes and garlic and herbs

examples.en: She dipped the crispy mozzarella sticks into a bowl of warm marinara sauce.
examples.zh: 她把香脆的马苏里拉芝士条浸入一碗温热的海员沙司中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 marinara 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 已过盛年的, 雕落的, 已过青春妙龄的, 过时的, 老式的, 陈旧的, 落伍的
lemmas.def_en: out of fashion

examples.en: Wearing skinny jeans is now widely considered quite passe among younger fashion trends.
examples.zh: 如今，在年轻人的时尚潮流中，穿紧身牛仔裤已被普遍认为相当过时。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 passe 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: hot or warm and humid

examples.en: The weather was so muggy that everyone preferred staying inside with the air conditioning.
examples.zh: 天气闷热难耐，大家都宁愿待在有空调的室内。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 muggy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: meat from a mature domestic sheep

examples.en: She wore a vintage coat trimmed with soft mouton around the collar.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件衣领饰有柔软染色羊皮的复古外套。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mouton 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 牛奶商, 送奶工, 挤奶的男人
lemmas.def_en: someone who delivers milk

examples.en: The milkman delivered fresh bottles to our doorstep early every morning.
examples.zh: 送奶工每天清晨都会把新鲜的牛奶送到我们门前。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 milkman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the middle of winter

examples.en: A heavy blanket of fresh snow covered the quiet village in midwinter.
examples.zh: 仲冬时节，厚厚的一层新雪覆盖了寂静的村庄。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 midwinter 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 有盖大汤锅, 小砂锅
lemmas.def_en: soup cooked in a large pot

examples.en: He simmered the hearty beef stew in a traditional ceramic marmite.
examples.zh: 他用传统的陶瓷大汤锅慢炖着那锅丰盛的牛肉。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 marmite 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any tree of the genus Macadamia

examples.en: She baked a fresh batch of white chocolate and macadamia nut cookies.
examples.zh: 她烤了一炉新鲜的白巧克力夏威夷果饼干。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 macadamia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a woody climbing usually tropical plant

examples.en: Thick lianas hung down from the high canopy of the tropical rainforest.
examples.zh: 粗壮的藤本植物从热带雨林高高的树冠上垂挂下来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 liana 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: baked dish of layers of lasagna pasta with sauce and cheese and meat or vegetables

examples.en: We ordered a piping hot dish of homemade beef lasagne for dinner.
examples.zh: 我们晚饭点了一份热气腾腾的自制牛肉烤宽面条。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lasagne 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 食物橱, 家用食品, 食物储藏室
lemmas.def_en: a supply of food especially for a household

examples.en: Grandma kept her homemade fruit jams and preserves in the cool larder.
examples.zh: 奶奶把自制的水果果酱和蜜饯存放在阴凉的食品储藏室里。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 larder 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 驾车兜风, 偷车乱开, 乘汽车兜风, 追求享受的行动, 胡作非为
lemmas.def_en: a ride in a car taken solely for pleasure

examples.en: Two reckless teenagers took a stolen sports car for a late-night joyride.
examples.zh: 两名鲁莽的少年开着一辆偷来的跑车在深夜飙车兜风。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 joyride 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 全神贯注的, 入迷的, 出神的
lemmas.def_en: feeling great rapture or delight

examples.en: The children listened in rapt silence as the storyteller began the tale.
examples.zh: 讲故事的人一开口，孩子们便全神贯注、鸦雀无声地听着。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rapt 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a detachment assigned to protect the rear of a (retreating) military body

examples.en: The brave rearguard fought fiercely to protect the main army's safe retreat.
examples.zh: 英勇的后卫部队奋勇作战，掩护主力部队安全撤退。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rearguard 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 三张相联的图画, 三幅一联
lemmas.def_en: art consisting of a painting or carving (especially an altarpiece) on three panels (usually hinged together)

examples.en: The museum proudly displayed a magnificent Renaissance triptych above the altar.
examples.zh: 博物馆在祭坛上方骄傲地展出了一幅壮丽的文艺复兴时期三联画。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 triptych 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: rather small

examples.en: They decided to rent a smallish apartment near the city center.
examples.zh: 他们决定在市中心附近租一套略小的公寓。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 smallish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a B vitamin that aids in body growth

examples.en: Many people take daily biotin supplements to help strengthen their hair and nails.
examples.zh: 许多人每天服用生物素补充剂以帮助强健头发和指甲。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 biotin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: partially automatic

examples.en: The factory installed new semiautomatic machinery to speed up the packaging process.
examples.zh: 工厂安装了新的半自动机器以加快包装流程。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 semiautomatic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (印度教)宗教虔诚(以对一个神的虔诚信奉求得自身的解脱)
lemmas.def_en: (Hinduism) loving devotion to a deity leading to salvation and nirvana; open to all persons independent of caste or sex

examples.en: The ancient temple echoed with sweet songs celebrating divine love and bhakti.
examples.zh: 古老寺庙里回荡着赞颂神圣之爱与虔敬信奉的优美歌声。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bhakti 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] д叶(用д叶卷一些槟榔子碎片及石灰,作为咀嚼剂,有强壮、兴奋作用)
lemmas.def_en: Asian pepper plant whose dried leaves are chewed with betel nut (seed of the betel palm) by southeast Asians

examples.en: Vendors along the street were selling fresh betel leaves wrapped with spices.
examples.zh: 街边的摊贩正在售卖包裹着香料的新鲜蒌叶。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 betel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the basic unit of money in Israel

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shekels 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 类人猿的, 猴子一般的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or resembling an ape

examples.en: The creature moved through the jungle trees with remarkable simian agility.
examples.zh: 该生物以猿猴般惊人的敏捷身手在丛林树木间穿梭。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 simian 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the trait of condescending to those of lower social status

examples.en: His intellectual snobbery alienated many of his colleagues at the university.
examples.zh: 他自命不凡的才智势利态度疏远了大学里的许多同事。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 snobbery 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 有皱纹的, 易生皱纹的
lemmas.def_en: marked by wrinkles

examples.en: The old man smiled warmly, his wrinkly face crinkling with pure joy.
examples.zh: 老人温和地笑了，满是皱纹的脸庞洋溢着纯粹的喜悦。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wrinkly 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a pen that has a small metal ball as the point of transfer of ink to paper

examples.en: Please sign your name on the contract using a blue ballpoint pen.
examples.zh: 请用蓝色圆珠笔在合同上签下您的名字。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ballpoint 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 石造物, 建筑物的石造部分, 石方工程, 石细工, 石匠工场, 石铺
lemmas.def_en: masonry done with stone

examples.en: The master mason carefully restored the crumbling medieval stonework of the cathedral.
examples.zh: 石匠大师精心修复了大教堂摇摇欲坠的中世纪石造部分。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stonework 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 运动失调, 无秩序, 混乱, 动作机能不协调, 共剂失调
lemmas.def_en: inability to coordinate voluntary muscle movements; unsteady movements and staggering gait

examples.en: Patients suffering from cerebellar ataxia often struggle with balance and precise finger movements.
examples.zh: 患有小脑共济失调的患者往往难以保持平衡和进行手指精细动作。

lemmas.def_zh: 运动失调的, 混乱的
lemmas.def_en: lacking motor coordination; marked or caused by ataxia

examples.en: The patient exhibited an ataxic gait, struggling to walk steadily in a straight line.
examples.zh: 该患者表现出共济失调步态，很难平稳地走直线。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ataxia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 传真电报, 传真电报机, 传真照片, 远距照相镜头, 摄远镜头
lemmas.def_en: a photograph made with a telephoto lens

examples.en: He attached a heavy telephoto lens to capture the distant wildlife clearly.
examples.zh: 他装上了一个沉重的长焦镜头，以便清晰拍摄远处的野生动物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 telephoto 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 结块, 聚结, 大块
lemmas.def_en: a jumbled collection or mass

examples.en: The capital has grown into an enormous industrial agglomeration over recent decades.
examples.zh: 近几十年来，该首都已发展成为一个庞大的工业集聚区。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 agglomeration 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: spherical Gram-positive bacteria occurring in pairs or chains; cause e.g. scarlet fever and tonsillitis

examples.en: The doctor prescribed antibiotics to clear up the severe streptococcus throat infection.
examples.zh: 医生开了抗生素以消除严重的链球菌性喉部感染。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or caused by streptococci

examples.en: The doctor prescribed antibiotics to quickly treat the patient's severe streptococcal throat infection.
examples.zh: 医生开了抗生素，以迅速治疗该患者严重的链球菌性咽喉感染。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 streptococcus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a lane at sea that is a regularly used route for vessels

examples.en: Cargo ships navigated the busy northern seaway despite the rough winter weather.
examples.zh: 尽管冬日天气恶劣，货船依然在繁忙的北方海运航线上航行。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 seaway 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: large metal container in which coal or charcoal is burned; warms people who must stay outside for long times

examples.en: The street vendor kept warm near a glowing charcoal brazier all night.
examples.zh: 小摊贩整夜靠在一个炽热的炭火盆旁取暖。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 brazier 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a puzzle where you decode a message consisting of pictures representing syllables and words

examples.en: The children laughed as they tried to solve the clever picture rebus.
examples.zh: 孩子们在努力解开这个巧妙的画谜时笑了起来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rebus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a variety of muskmelon vine having fruit with a tan rind and orange flesh

examples.en: She sliced a ripe cantaloupe and served it chilled for summer breakfast.
examples.zh: 她切开一个成熟的罗马甜瓜，冷藏后作为夏季早餐端上桌。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cantaloupe 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: ubiquitous strong-scented mat-forming Eurasian herb of wasteland, hedgerow or pasture having narrow serrate leaves and small usually white florets; widely naturalized in North America

examples.en: Traditional herbalists often use wild yarrow leaves to help stop minor bleeding.
examples.zh: 传统草药师常使用野生蓍草叶来帮助止住轻微出血。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 yarrow 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: large ornamental tropical American tree with bipinnate leaves and globose clusters of flowers with crimson stamens and seed pods that are eaten by cattle

examples.en: Cattle rested comfortably beneath the broad shade of an ancient zaman tree.
examples.zh: 牛群在一棵古老的雨豆树宽阔的树荫下惬意休憩。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 zaman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: ten-armed oval-bodied cephalopod with narrow fins as long as the body and a large calcareous internal shell

examples.en: The cuttlefish released a dark cloud of ink to confuse its predator.
examples.zh: 乌贼喷出一团黑色的墨汁来迷惑捕食者。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cuttlefish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 楔形的, 楔形文字的, 楔状骨的
lemmas.def_en: shaped like a wedge

examples.en: Scholars spent months translating the ancient cuneiform inscriptions on the clay tablet.
examples.zh: 学者们花了数月时间翻译泥板上古老的楔形文字铭文。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cuneiform 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a white crystalline oxide; used in refractories and in insulation and abrasives and enamels and glazes

examples.en: The dentist recommended a durable zirconia crown to replace the broken molar.
examples.zh: 牙医建议使用耐用的氧化锆牙冠来替换损坏的臼齿。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 zirconia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 小船室, (小船上的)厨房, 小房间
lemmas.def_en: the galley or pantry of a small ship

examples.en: The crew stored their fishing gear inside the small boat's cramped cuddy.
examples.zh: 船员们将捕鱼用具存放在小船狭窄的船舱里。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cuddy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a person who likes to be active late at night

examples.en: As a habitual nighthawk, he preferred writing code in the quiet midnight hours.
examples.zh: 作为一个习惯性的夜猫子，他更喜欢在寂静的午夜编写代码。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nighthawk 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: small farmers and tenants

examples.en: The local cotton cropper struggled to maintain his yield during the severe drought.
examples.zh: 当地的棉花种植者在严重干旱期间艰难维持产量。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cropper 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: rub rosin onto

examples.en: The violinist carefully rosined her bow before stepping onto the concert stage.
examples.zh: 小提琴手在登上音乐会舞台前仔细地为琴弓擦拭松香。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rosin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: actions taken by a government to defeat insurgency

examples.en: Military experts designed a new counterinsurgency doctrine to protect vulnerable rural communities.
examples.zh: 军事专家设计了新的反暴乱作战原则以保护脆弱的乡村社区。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 counterinsurgency 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a small restaurant where drinks and snacks are sold

examples.en: Poets and thinkers gathered at the historic coffeehouse to debate radical ideas.
examples.zh: 诗人和思想家聚集在这家历史悠久的咖啡馆辩论激进观点。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 coffeehouse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: soft decayed area in a tooth; progressive decay can lead to the death of a tooth

examples.en: Regular flossing helps prevent dental caries and protects your teeth from decay.
examples.zh: 经常使用牙线有助于预防龋齿并保护牙齿免受蛀蚀。

lemmas.def_zh: 龋的, 骨疡的, 腐烂的
lemmas.def_en: (of teeth) affected with cavities or decay

examples.en: The dentist recommended extracting the heavily carious tooth before the underlying infection spread further.
examples.zh: 牙医建议在潜在感染进一步扩散前拔掉那颗严重龋坏的牙齿。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 caries 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a contagious viral disease that is a milder form of measles lasting three or four days; can be damaging to a fetus during the first trimester

examples.en: Public health clinics provide vaccinations to protect expectant mothers against rubella.
examples.zh: 公共卫生诊所提供疫苗接种，以保护孕妇免受风疹感染。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rubella 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the study of the supposed occult influence of numbers on human affairs

examples.en: She consults numerology charts regularly to find lucky dates for important meetings.
examples.zh: 她经常查阅数字命理表，以便为重要会议挑选吉日。

lemmas.def_en: a believer in numerology

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 数字命理学的；命理学上的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to numerology

family_guide.root_logic: 以 numerology 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: travel around, either by plane or ship

examples.en: The adventurous sailor plans to circumnavigate the globe in a small yacht.
examples.zh: 这位冒险的航海家计划驾驶一艘小帆船环球航行。

lemmas.def_en: traveling around something (by ship or plane)

examples.en: Magellan's circumnavigation of the earth proved that it is a globe

family_guide.root_logic: 以 circumnavigate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a strong post (as on a wharf or quay or ship for attaching mooring lines)

examples.en: The sailor secured the heavy mooring rope firmly around the iron bollard.
examples.zh: 水手将粗重的系泊缆绳牢牢系在铁系船柱上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bollard 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a pedestrian who walks from place to place

examples.en: A tired wayfarer stopped at the tavern to ask for food and shelter.
examples.zh: 一位疲惫的旅行者停在客栈前，寻求食物和住处。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wayfarer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: someone who smokes marijuana habitually

examples.en: His roommates thought he was a lazy pothead who smoked weed all day.
examples.zh: 室友们觉得他是个整天抽大麻的无所事事的大麻鬼。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pothead 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: learn something again, as after having forgotten or neglected it

examples.en: After the accident, he had to relearn how to walk and write properly.
examples.zh: 事故发生后，他不得不重新学习如何正常走路和写字。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 relearn 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an extremely hot day

examples.en: Tomorrow is going to be a real scorcher, so stay indoors if possible.
examples.zh: 明天会是个名副其实的大热天，所以尽量待在室内。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scorcher 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 响亮持久的声音, 钟声

examples.en: A sudden peal of thunder shook the entire house during the summer storm.
examples.zh: 夏日暴风雨中，一声突如其来的雷鸣震动了整座房屋。

lemmas.def_en: ring recurrently

examples.en: A sudden peal of thunder shook the entire house during the summer storm.
examples.zh: 夏日暴风雨中，一声突如其来的雷鸣震动了整座房屋。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 peal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a witty saying

examples.en: The witty playwright opened his speech with a clever and memorable epigram.
examples.zh: 这位机智的剧作家用一句巧妙且令人难忘的警句开场。

lemmas.def_en: terse and witty and like a maxim

examples.en: The critic was famous for his epigrammatic reviews that were both witty and sharp.
examples.zh: 这位评论家以其既风趣又尖锐的警句式评论而闻名。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 epigram 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the fleshy pendulous part of the external human ear

examples.en: She rubbed her earlobe nervously while waiting for the test results to arrive.
examples.zh: 在等待测试结果到来时，她紧张地揉着耳垂。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 earlobe 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: act nervously; be undecided; be uncertain

examples.en: Stop dithering over the menu and just order whatever you feel like eating.
examples.zh: 别再对着菜单犹豫不决了，想吃什么就直接点吧。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dither 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a potent substance that acts like a hormone and is found in many bodily tissues (and especially in semen); produced in response to trauma and may affect blood pressure and metabolism and smooth muscle activity

examples.en: Aspirin works by inhibiting the production of prostaglandin in the human body.
examples.zh: 阿司匹林通过抑制人体内前列腺素的产生来发挥作用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 prostaglandin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 解除武装, 废除军备
lemmas.def_en: do away with the military organization and potential of

examples.en: Both nations signed a historic treaty to completely demilitarize the disputed border region.
examples.zh: 两国签署了一项历史性条约，使争议边界地区彻底非军事化。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 demilitarize 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: someone who travels for pleasure

examples.en: Thousands of holidaymakers crowded the sandy beaches during the warm sunny weekend.
examples.zh: 在这个温暖晴朗的周末，成千上万的度假者挤满了沙滩。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 holidaymaker 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: predominantly photosynthetic prokaryotic organisms containing a blue pigment in addition to chlorophyll; occur singly or in colonies in diverse habitats; important as phytoplankton

examples.en: Ancient cyanobacteria played a vital role in producing the Earth's early oxygen.
examples.zh: 古老的蓝细菌在产生地球早期氧气方面发挥了重要作用。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or caused by photosynthetic bacteria of the class Cyanobacteria

lemmas.def_zh: 使复活, 鼓舞, 鼓励

examples.en: The cool morning breeze helped reanimate his exhausted body after the hike.
examples.zh: 徒步旅行后，清晨凉爽的微风让他疲惫的身躯重新焕发了活力。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 reanimate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 时髦地, 按照流行地

examples.en: She arrived fashionably late to the dinner party, wearing an elegant dress.

lemmas.def_zh: 乏味的, 走了气味的, 无生气的, 无趣味的

examples.zh: 听着他们关于明星八卦的乏味谈话，我很快就感到厌烦了。

lemmas.def_zh: 乏味, 走气, 无生气, 无趣
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being vapid and unsophisticated

lemmas.def_en: a metric unit of volume equal to one thousandth of a liter

examples.en: The doctor instructed him to take exactly five milliliters of cough syrup.
examples.zh: 医生指示他准确服用五毫升的止咳糖浆。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 milliliter 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 鸽棚, 鸽子出入孔, 分类架, 粗略分类, 鸽棚般的小房间
lemmas.def_en: a specific (often simplistic) category

examples.en: Critics tried to pigeonhole his unique musical style into one single genre.

lemmas.def_en: place into a small compartment

examples.zh: 评论家们试图将他独特的音乐风格归类为单一流派。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pigeonhole 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: Soviet communism

examples.zh: 该社会重视集体主义而非个人主义，强调社区福祉和共同责任。

lemmas.def_en: subscribing to the socialistic doctrine of ownership by the people collectively

examples.en: The country adopted a collectivist system that prioritized communal welfare over individual profit.

lemmas.def_en: subscribing to the socialistic doctrine of ownership by the people collectively

lemmas.def_en: small slender toy spaniel with erect ears and a black-spotted brown to white coat

examples.zh: 她每天清晨都带着她那只精力充沛的蝶耳犬在公园散步。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or affecting the peritoneum

lemmas.def_zh: 模仿作品, 东拼西凑的杂烩
lemmas.def_en: a musical composition consisting of a series of songs or other musical pieces from various sources

lemmas.def_zh: 繁茂, 蔓延, 过度发育, 增生

family_guide.root_logic: 以 overgrowth 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 大量, 慷慨, 挥霍, 充沛, 浪费

family_guide.root_logic: 以 profusion 为核心的派生词族。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 machiavellian 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a musician who plays a keyboard instrument

family_guide.root_logic: 以 keyboardist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the branch of dentistry dealing with the prevention or correction of irregularities of the teeth

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pullback 为核心的派生词族。

examples.zh: 一大群角马开始了穿越河流的危险旅程。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wildebeest 为核心的派生词族。

examples.zh: 由于暴雨倾盆，户外音乐节彻底泡汤了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 washout 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 性爱的, 性交的, 性病的, 生殖器的

lemmas.def_en: of someone who has not been married

examples.zh: 该社会组织为有需要的年轻未婚母亲建立了一所专门的庇护所。

lemmas.def_en: spotlessly clean and fresh

examples.zh: 在下一个向右的岔道口下高速，即可到达那座历史悠久的海滨村庄。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 turnoff 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a Russian carriage pulled by three horses abreast

examples.zh: 公司目前由三位经验丰富且雄心勃勃的高管组成的三驾马车共同掌舵。
